36121014.desc: Increases the Max HP of allies within the energy field. The power supply will recharge each time your allies successfully dodge an attack. Only active when Xenon is inside the field. Change mode with Modal Shift.
36121014.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration of hypogram field: #time sec.\nAlly Max HP Boost: #indieMhpR%, Power units recharged when allies evade: +1.

36121052.name: Orbital Cataclysm
36121052.desc: Fires a powerful orbital laser cannon that can incinerate anything on the ground. Not affected by cooldown reduction effects.
36121052.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Invincible during casting, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

36121053.name: Entangling Lash
36121053.desc: Swings your energy sword at enemies in the direction you're facing to dispel some buffs, bind them, and stun them. Bound enemies cannot have buff effects applied for the duration of the stun.\nDebuffs: Attack Power/Magic ATT Increase, DEF Increase, Obsidian Skin.\nEnemies hit by this will resist stuns for 90 seconds and won't be stunned by other skills, like Entangling Lash.
36121053.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Chance to Debuff: #prop%, Bind Duration: #time sec.\nBind Duration: +100% depending on damage inflicted with Entangling Lash.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

36121054.name: Amaranth Generator
36121054.desc: Activates the Amaranth Generator, which supplies you with infinite power for a short time.
36121054.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Gauge Charge: Max, Charge duration: #time sec\n\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

37000006.name: Blast Shield
37000006.desc: When attacked by an enemy, generates a protective shield proportional to the damage taken. The total of the shield and current HP can't exceed the max HP or the shield will disappear. While using Blaster skills, you cannot be knocked back.
37000006.h: When hit, converts #x% of your damage taken into a protective shield. #y% + #z of the shield dissipates every second. The maximum strength of the shield is equal to your Max HP.\nKnockback Resistance increases by 100% while using Blaster skills.\nPermanently increases Knockback Resistance by #stanceProp%, Defense by #pddX, and Max HP by #mhpR%.

37000007.name: Revolving Cannon Mastery
37000007.desc: Study the Arm Cannon to learn the basics of Revolving Cannon. Any enemies attacked directly by an Arm Cannon will receive additional damage due to the excess heat.
37000007.h: #c[Final Attack Skill]# When a direct attack from the Arm Cannon lands, it triggers additional attacks which deal #damage% on up to #mobCount enemies.\nPermanently increases Movement Speed by #psdSpeed, Jump Power by #psdJump, and Max Movement Speed by #speedMax.

37001000.name: Magnum Punch
37001000.desc: Unleashes a powerful straight punch in front of you with the explosive power of the Arm Cannon. Revolving Cannon triggers automatically when using this skill. You can also link this skill to Double Blast and Bullet Blast.
37001000.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount.\nRevolving Cannon triggers automatically while using Magnum Punch and will additionally attack the same number of enemies for #y% damage #x times.

37001001.name: Revolving Cannon
37001001.desc: Use your Arm Cannon to create additional explosions and deal damage. This cannot be used as a standalone skill. Either it triggers automatically during certain attacks or can be used manually during a certain attack.\nHolding the key down to charge will manually reload your Ammo. You can charge while using other skills, and can charge up to 2 skills simultaneously.\n#cSkills triggered automatically during Revolving Cannon: Magnum Punch, Double Blast#
37001001.h: Uses 1 Ammo, and your Ammo is reloaded if used as a key-down skill

37001002.name: Bunker Buster Explosion
37001002.desc: Depletes the Dynamo Gauge to fire your Bunker Buster, releasing explosions and shockwaves. Ignores Defense Rate of enemies in melee range. Can be linked into Hammer Smash.\nThe Dynamo Gauge charges when using Revolving Cannon during certain offensive skills. Additional shockwaves are released based on Dynamo Gauge bars used, dealing extra damage based on proximity. Unaffected by attack reflection.
37001002.h: Requires #x or more Dynamo Gauge bars. Attack up to #mobCount enemies for #damage% damage #attackCount times. Melee hits ignore #ignoreMobpdpR% of enemy Defense Rate.\nReleases Shockwave 1, attacking up to #q enemies for #w% damage #w2 times.\n#cAfter use, you will Overheat for #time sec. While Overheated, the Dynamo Gauge is set to max, and you cannot charge the Dynamo Gauge or use Bunker Buster Explosion.# On ending, depletes the Dynamo Gauge.

37001003.name: Double Jump
37001003.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, allows you to jump a greater distance

37001004.name: Detonate
37001004.desc: Fire your cannon to thrust in the direction opposite the way you are facing. The recoil that thrusts you will also damage nearby enemies. Using the skill while holding the up arrow key will cause an explosion on the ground that propels you upward. Attacking an enemy with attack reflection will not damage you, and the skill cannot be used while reloading.
37001004.h: Ammo Cost: 1, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount

37100004.name: Arm Cannon Mastery
37100004.desc: Increases Arm Cannon Mastery, Critical Rate, and Attack Power.
37100004.h: Mastery +#mastery%, Critical Rate +#cr%, and Attack Power +#padX

37100005.name: Physical Training
37100005.desc: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.
37100005.h: Permanently increase STR by #strX and DEX by #dexX.

37100006.name: Charge Mastery
37100006.desc: Maintain control over your power to improve charge skills. Additionally, permanently increases Damage.
37100006.h: Decreases the charge time for all charge skills by #x%. Using a charge skill or Hammer Smash Blast reloads #w Ammo immediately but will not interrupt an auto-reload.\nAt the start of charged Bobbing, Weaving, Hammer Smash, or Hammer Smash Blast, all damage taken is briefly reduced by #y%, including attacks that deal damage based on your Max HP.\nPermanently increases damage by #damR%.

37100007.name: Revolving Cannon Plus
37100007.desc: Improves the performance of the Revolving Cannon embedded within your Arm Cannon.
37100007.h:
Bunker Buster Explosion damage +#w% points, Shockwave 1 damage +#w2% points
Additional attack damage due to overheating: +#s% points
Revolving Cannon damage triggered during Magnum Punch +#s2% points.
Maximum Dynamo Gauge capacity expanded to 4 bars. Maximum Ammo increased to 4.
Using Bunker Buster Explosion while the Dynamo Gauge is at 4 bars or higher increases damage by 40% points and will generate Shockwave 2, which attacks up to #dot enemies for #q% damage #q2 times.

37101000.name: Double Blast
37101000.desc: Performs a powerful 2-hit combo in the direction you're facing using the momentum from your Arm Cannon. After you learn this skill, you can also activate it by repeatedly pressing the Magnum Punch button. Revolving Cannon triggers automatically when using this skill. Can be linked to Bobbing, Weaving, Hammer Smash, Shotgun Punch, or Bullet Blast.
37101000.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount.\nRevolving Cannon triggers automatically while using Double Blast and will additionally attack the same number of enemies for #y% damage #x times.

37101001.name: Bobbing
37101001.desc: Move forward while avoiding enemy attacks. Jumping will cancel this skill immediately. With Action Customization enabled, pressing the skill key again will cancel the skill immediately. Can be linked to Magnum Punch, Rocket Rush, or Bullet Blast.\nIf activated after a charge, #cany of your skill that was already activated will be canceled, and Bobbing will be activated.# You can charge a skill while using a different skill other than Bobbing, and up to 2 skills can be charged simultaneously. Also permanently increases Magnum Punch damage.\n#cRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.#
37101001.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Bonus Avoidability #w% applied for 1.5 sec after activation.\n[Passive Effect - Magnum Punch Damage: +#damPlus% points]

37101003.name: Arm Cannon Boost
37101003.desc: Doubles the Attack Speed of your weapon. Must have a Arm Cannon equipped.
37101003.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec, Weapon Attack Speed: +2

37111006.name: Magnum Cannon
37111006.desc: The cannon built into the Arm Cannon fires an explosive shell forward.
37111006.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Consumed Bullets: #s2\nMax Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Damage Against Normal Monsters: +#q%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

37110007.name: Revolving Cannon Plus II
37110007.desc: Improves the performance of the Revolving Cannon embedded within your Arm Cannon. This overwrites the increases from Revolving Cannon Plus.
37110007.h:
Bunker Buster Explosion damage +#w% points, Shockwave 1 damage +#w2% points, and Shockwave 2 damage +#u% points
Additional attack damage due to overheating +#s% points
Revolving Cannon damage triggered during Magnum Punch +#s2% points, Revolving Cannon damage during Double Blast +#v% points
Maximum Dynamo Gauge capacity expanded to 5 slots, maximum number of Bullets increased to 5.
Using Bunker Buster Explosion while the Dynamo Gauge is at 5 slots or higher increases its damage by 80% points and will generate Shockwave 3, which attacks up to #dot enemies for #q% damage #q2 times.

37110008.name: Shield Training
37110008.desc: Fortify your Blast Shield with some training. Also permanently increases Final Damage.
37110008.h: When hit, convert #x% of damage taken into a protective shield. #y% + #z of the shield dissipates each second. The maximum potential for the shield is equal to your Max HP.\nPermanently increases Abnormal Status Resistance by #asrR, Elemental Resistance by #terR%, and Final Damage by #pdR%.

37110009.name: Combo Training
37110009.desc: Research the most efficient movement and attack patterns to increase your abilities in battle.
37110009.h: Attack Speed: +#dummyStr, Skill Link Speed: +#z, Final Damage: +#x%, Attack Power: +#padR%

37111000.name: Hammer Smash
37111000.desc:
Strikes the ground with tremendous force to send enemies reeling.
Can be linked to Magnum Punch or Bullet Blast.
Charge the skill by holding down the key. #cWhile charging, attacks won't knock you back. Releasing the charge will cancel any of your active skills and will activate Hammer Smash.#
You can charge this skill while using other skills, except for Hammer Smash. Up to 2 skills may be charged at once.
#cWhile Cannon Overdrive's cylinder gauge overheat reduction is active#, Hammer Smash is converted into #cHammer Smash Blast#.
Also permanently increases Double Blast damage.
37111000.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon
Enhanced to #cHammer Smash Blast# while Cannon Overdrive's cylinder gauge overheat reduction is active
#cHammer Smash Blast# - MP Cost: #dummyStr, attacks up to #dummyStr2 enemies #dummyStr4 times for #dummyStr3% damage
[Passive Effect: Double Blast Damage +#damPlus% (additive)]

37111003.name: Weaving
37111003.desc: Move backward while avoiding enemy attacks. Jumping will cancel this skill immediately. With Action Customization enabled, press the skill key again to immediately cancel it. Can be linked to Rocket Rush, Muzzle Flash, or Bullet Blast.\nIf activated after a charge, #cany of your skill that was already activated will be canceled, and Weaving will be activated.# You can charge a skill while using a different skill other than Weaving, and up to 2 skills can be charged simultaneously. Additionally, permanently increases Magnum Punch damage.\n#cRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.#
37111003.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Bonus Avoidability #w% applied for 1.5 sec after activation.\n[Passive Effect - Magnum Punch Damage: +#damPlus% points]

37111005.name: Rocket Rush
37111005.desc: Grab onto nearby enemies and drag them in the direction you're facing. Any enemy in your path will be bulldozed along and receive damage. This skill will not be activated if there are no enemies nearby to grab. Can be resisted by some monsters.
37111005.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Damage: #damage%, Number of Enemies: #mobCount. If there are enemies in the skill's path, Max Enemies Hit: #q, Damage: #q2%, Number of Attacks: #w, Damage Against Normal Enemies: +#nbdR%.

37120002.name: Muzzle Flash
37120002.desc: Instantly approaches a nearby enemy while Weaving to perform an attack. Can only be used during Weaving, and can be activated by Weaving (unless Action Customization is enabled for that skill). If command is locked, it will not activate even if you use the skill while Weaving. It will not be activated if there is no enemy within range. Can be linked to Magnum Punch and Bullet Blast, and permanently increases Magnum Punch damage.\n#cRight-click to lock command#
37120002.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Damage: #damage%, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Number of Attacks: #attackCount\n[Passive Effect - Magnum Punch Damage: +#damPlus% points]

37120008.name: Revolving Cannon Plus III
37120008.desc: The final upgrade for the Revolving Cannon embedded within your Arm Cannon. This overwrites the increases from Revolving Cannon Plus II.
37120008.h:
Bunker Buster Explosion damage +#w% points, Shockwave 1 damage +#w2% points, Shockwave 2 damage +#u% points, and Shockwave 3 damage +#u2% points.
Additional attack damage due to overheating +#s% points
Revolving Cannon damage triggered during Magnum Punch +#s2% points, Revolving Cannon damage during Double Blast +#v% points.
Maximum Dynamo Gauge capacity expanded to 6 slots, maximum number of Bullets increased to 6.
Using Bunker Buster Explosion while the Dynamo Gauge is at 6 slots or higher increases its damage by 200% points and will generate Shockwave 4, which attacks up to #dot enemies for #q% damage #q2 times.

37120009.name: Shield Training II
37120009.desc: Enhance the Blast Shield through rigorous mental training and perseverance. Additionally, permanently increase the damage of Rocket Rush and Magnum Cannon.
37120009.h: When hit, convert #x% of damage taken into a protective shield. #y% + #z of the shield dissipates each second. The maximum potential for the shield is equal to your Max HP.\nPermanently increase Abnormal Status Resistance by #asrR%, Elemental Resistance by #terR%, and Knockback Resistance by #stanceProp%.\nKnockback attack of Rocket Rush and Magnum Cannon damage +#damPlus% (additive).

37120010.name: Gauntlet Expert
37120010.desc: Increases Arm Cannon Mastery, Critical Damage, and Damage when attacking Boss Monsters.

37120011.name: Advanced Charge Mastery
37120011.desc: Maintain control over your power to optimize charge skills. Overwrites the buffs from Charge Mastery. Additionally, permanently ignores a portion of enemies' Defense when attacking, and decreases damage taken.
37120011.h: Decreases the charge time for all charge skills by #x%. Using a charge skill or Hammer Smash Blast reloads #w Ammo immediately, but will not interrupt an auto-reload.\nAt the start of charged Bobbing, Weaving, Hammer Smash, or Hammer Smash Blast, all damage taken is briefly reduced by #y%, including attacks that deal damage based on your Max HP.\nPermanently ignore #ignoreMobpdpR% of enemies' Defense, and damage taken is reduced by #damAbsorbShieldR%.

37120012.name: Combo Training II
37120012.desc: Research the most efficient movement and attack patterns to increase your abilities in battle. Abilities that increase Skill Link Speed and Final Damage override enhancements from Combo Training.
37120012.h: Skill Link Speed: +#z level(s), Final Damage: +#x%, Critical Rate: +#cr%, Attack Power: +#padX

37120043.name: Power Punch
37120043.desc: Increases the damage of Magnum Punch, Double Blast, Hammer Smash Blast, Shotgun Punch, Muzzle Flash, and Ballistic Hurricane.

37120044.name: Piercing Punch
37120044.desc: Increases Ignore Defense from Magnum Punch, Double Blast, Hammer Smash Blast, Shotgun Punch, Muzzle Flash, and Ballistic Hurricane.

37120045.name: Punching Extra Strike
37120045.desc: Increases the number of attacks for Hammer Smash Blast and Shotgun Punch.

37120046.name: Improved Bunker Explosion
37120046.desc: Increases the damage of Bunker Buster Explosion.

37120047.name: Improved Bunker Shockwave
37120047.desc: Increases the damage of the shockwave generated by Bunker Buster Explosion.

37120048.name: Bunker Buster Explosion - Guard Bonus
37120048.desc: Grants a guarding bonus during Bunker Buster Explosion.
37120048.h: Guard bonus during Bunker Buster Explosion. Damage reduction rate follows the rates in Charge Mastery.

37120049.name: Blast Shield Recovery
37120049.desc: While the Blast Shield dissipates, recover your HP relative to the rate at which your shield dissipates.
37120049.h: Recover #x% of the dissipating Blast Shield as HP.

37120050.name: Speedy Vitality Shield
37120050.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Vitality Shield.

37120051.name: Ballistic Hurricane - Reinforce
37120051.desc: Increases the damage of Ballistic Hurricane.

37121000.name: Shotgun Punch
37121000.desc: Fires a Screw Blow. Can be linked with Bobbing, Weaving, and Bullet Blast. Also permanently increases Double Blast damage.
37121000.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount\nNormal Enemy Damage: +#nbdR%\n[Passive Effect - Double Blast Damage: +#w% points]

37121003.name: Ballistic Hurricane
37121003.desc: Unleash all of your fighting prowess to create a storm that sweeps enemies in a wide range. Also permanently increases damage of Hammer Smash Blast.
37121003.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount\nCooldown: #cooltime sec\n[Passive Effect - Hammer Smash Blast Damage: +#damPlus% (additive)]

37121004.name: Revolving Blast
37121004.desc: Reloads Ammo. Unleash a powerful explosion to suppress enemies.
37121004.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount\nStun Duration: #time sec. Stun Duration: +100% depending on damage inflicted with Revolving Blast.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

37121005.name: Vitality Shield
37121005.desc: Convert an active Blast Shield to HP. You can't use this without a Blast Shield active, or if your HP is full. For a brief moment after using this skill, damage from attacks, including attacks that deal a percentage of your HP, will be reduced. The damage reduction is determined by the damage reduction of Charge Mastery. This buff is not affected by buff duration extension effects. Additionally, this skill permanently increases Rocket Rush and Magnum Cannon damage.
37121005.h: MP Cost: #mpCon. Recovers HP equal to the sum of the dissipated Blast Shield and #x% of your Max HP. The extended defense period lasts for #time sec.\nKnockback attack of Rocket Rush and Magnum Cannon damage increased by #damPlus% points.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

37121006.name: Maple Warrior
37121006.desc: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.
37121006.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Goddess of Maple World appears\n[Passive Effect: All stats with a direct AP investment increase by #basicStatUp%.]

37121007.name: Hero's Will
37121007.desc: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

37121052.name: Hyper Magnum Punch
37121052.desc:
Rush forward with a powerful punch to cause a colossal explosion. 
Hold down the skill key to charge. This skill generates additional shockwaves based on charge time, dealing more damage to nearby enemies. While charging, you cannot be stunned or knocked back, and you will have improved defense and Abnormal Status resistance.
Additionally, being attacked while charging will improve your final damage output.
Hyper Magnum Punch's charge time is unaffected by Charge Mastery's charge time reduction effect.
37121052.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Invincibility for #dummyStr sec.
Attacks up to #mobCount enemies for #damage% #attackCount times.
Generates a shockwave that attacks for #v% damage #v2 times.
Can be enhanced up to #z levels by charging, and each level of enhancement generates an additional shockwave that deals #q%, #q2%, #s2% damage #dot times.
While charging, the defense boosts from Charge Mastery are applied, and Abnormal Status Resistance increases by 100.
Each time you get hit while charging, the final damage increases by #x%, up to #y%.
Can be charged for up to #subTime sec.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

37121053.name: For Liberty
37121053.desc: Materializes the will of the Resistance to increase attack power.
37121053.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec., Damage: +#indieDamR%\nOnly applies to Demon, Resistance, and Xenon party members.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

37121054.name: Cannon Overdrive
37121054.desc: By charging Revolving Cannon to its limit, increase its power and reduce reload time, all while increasing the rate at which the Dynamo Gauge cools down.
37121054.h: MP Cost: #mpCon. Duration: #time sec. Increases damage for skills that use Ammo by #y%. Ammo auto-reload time decreased by #x%. The Dynamo Gauge Overheat duration for Bunker Buster Explosion is reduced to 1 second up to #z time(s). While Dynamo Gauge Overheat Reduction is active, Hammer Smash becomes #cHammer Smash Blast# and can be used up to #u time(s).\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

50000012.name: Blessing of the Fairy
50000012.desc: Grants 1 skill level for every 10 levels your highest level character has. Blessing of the Fairy and Empress's Blessing do not stack, so only the strongest skill will be active.

50000073.name: Empress's Blessing
50000073.desc: For every 5 levels on your highest level Cygnus Knight or Mihile character, this skill will gain 1 Skill Point. Blessing of the Fairy and Empress's Blessing do not stack, so only the strongest skill will be active.\r\nThis skill can reach a max of Lv. 30, based on your Cygnus Knight or Mihile character's Noble Mind skill.

50000074.name: Empress's Shout
50000074.desc: Permanently increases Max HP and Max MP.

50000086.name: Archangelic Blessing
50000086.h1: Attack Power: +5, Magic ATT: +5, Duration: 10 min

50000091.name: Archangelic Blessing
50000091.h1: Attack Power: +5, Magic ATT: +5, Duration: 10 min

50000093.name: Hidden Potential (Cygnus Knight)
50000093.pdesc: Unlock your hidden potential in your moment of need.
50000093.ph: Damage Over Time: #damage% damage to nearby enemies while HP is below #z%. Avoidability: +#y%.

50000099.name: Ice Smash
50000099.pdesc: Transform your axe into a giant sword to freeze multiple enemies at once. Usable when Ice Gauge is charged to #c20 or higher#.\n[Command: #cUp, Up + Attack Key#]
50000099.ph: Ice Gauge Cost: #iceGageCon, Damage: #damage%, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Freeze Chance: #prop%, Freeze Duration: #time sec

50000100.name: Ice Tempest
50000100.pdesc: Damages enemies over time with a blast of icy power. Usable when Ice Gauge is charged to #c40 or higher#.\n[Command: #cDown, Right + Attack Key#]
50000100.ph: Ice Gauge Cost: #iceGageCon, Damage: #damage%, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Damage Over Time: #dot% damage every 1 sec for #dotTime sec.

50000103.name: Ice Chop
50000103.pdesc: Strike enemies hard with a chance to stun. Usable when Ice Gauge is charged to #c5 or higher.#\n[Command: #cDown + Attack Key#]
50000103.ph: Ice Gauge Cost: #iceGageCon, Damage: #damage%, Max Monsters Hit: #mobCount, Stun Chance: #prop%, Stun Duration: #time sec

50000104.name: Ice Curse
50000104.pdesc: Curse your opponents by turning them into Ice Snails. Usable when Ice Gauge is charged to #c160 or higher#.\n[Command: #cDown, Up + Attack Key#]
50000104.ph: Ice Gauge Cost: #iceGageCon. Snail Chance: #prop%, Snail Duration: #time

50000180.name: White Angelic Blessing
50000180.h1: Attack Power: 12, Magic ATT: 12, Duration: 10 min.

50000190.name: Will of the Alliance
50000190.desc: Draw power and inspiration from the willpower of the Alliance.
50000190.h: Permanently increases STR: +#strX, DEX: #dexX, INT: #intX, LUK: #lukX, ATT: #padX, Magic ATT: #madX

50000201.name: Benediction of the Fairy
50000201.desc: Cygnus's Blessing enhances your fighting spirit. Skill Points increase by 1 when a Cygnus Knight character reaches Lv. 30, 50, 70, 100, and 120.

50000202.name: Noble Mind
50000202.h: Increase Empress's Blessing max level by #x

50000250.name: Elemental Expert
50000250.desc: Become an expert of the elements to increase Attack Power and Magic ATT.

50001000.name: Three Snails
50001000.desc: [Master Level: 3]\nHurls snail shells to attack monsters from long distance.

50001001.name: Recovery
50001001.desc: [Master Level: 3]\nAllows you to steadily recover HP for 30 sec. \n#cCooldown: 2 min#
50001001.h1: MP Cost: 5, Recover 24 HP over 30 sec
50001001.h2: MP Cost: 10, Recover 48 HP over 30 sec
50001001.h3: MP Cost: 15, Recover 72 HP over 30 sec

50001002.name: Nimble Feet
50001002.desc: [Master Level: 3]\nTemporarily enables the user to move around quickly. \n#cCooldown: 1 min#
50001002.h1: MP Cost: 4, Duration: 4 sec, Movement Speed: 10
50001002.h2: MP Cost: 7, Duration: 8 sec, Movement Speed: 15
50001002.h3: MP Cost: 10, Duration: 12 sec, Movement Speed: 20

50001003.name: Legendary Spirit
50001003.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nWith the aid of a legendary spirit, you can now use scrolls on items that you can't equip.

50001004.name: Monster Mount
50001004.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nAllows you to ride a tamed monster.

50001005.name: Hero's Echo
50001005.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nIncreases the Attack Power and Magic ATT of all nearby characters.
50001005.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec, Attack Power & Magic ATT: +#x%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.
50001005.h1: MP Cost: 30, Attack Power and Magic ATT: +4%, Duration: 40 min

50001007.name: Maker
50001007.desc: [Master Level: 3]\nAllows you to use alchemy to create items. The items you can create depend on your character level.
50001007.h1: Allows you to create items under Lv. 75.
50001007.h2: Allows you to create items under Lv. 105.
50001007.h3: Allows you to create items under Lv. 135.

50001009.name: Bamboo Rain
50001009.desc: Uses bamboo to attack an enemy.

50001014.name: Spaceship
50001014.desc: [Master Level: 2]\nAllows you to board a Spaceship. Tapping left or right twice enhances Movement Speed and Jump. #cExpires: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM AM/PM UTC#

50001015.name: Space Dash
50001015.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nTapping left or right twice enhances Movement Speed and Jump. #cExpires: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM AM/PM UTC#

50001016.name: Space Beam
50001016.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nChanges the condition of the Krypto found at the Space Mine. #cExpires: MM/DD/YYYY (Day) HH:MM AM/PM UTC#

50001019.name: Yeti Mount
50001019.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nAllows you to ride a Yeti.\n#cExpires: TKTKTK#

50001020.name: Rage of Pharaoh
50001020.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nUtilizes the rage of the Pharaoh as an attack.
50001020.h1: Eliminates all enemies inside the Pyramid with a single blow.

50001022.name: Yeti Mount
50001022.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nAllows you to ride a Yeti.

50001023.name: Witch's Broomstick
50001023.desc: [Master Level: 1]\nAllows you to ride a Broomstick.

50001025.name: Charge! Toy Trojan

80004363.desc: Immerse your surroundings in dark magic and call upon netherworld lightning. When Dark Shock is created, or an attack skill is activated, netherworld lightning attacks the area.\nCreates a netherworld passage around the character periodically. Pressing a directional button will teleport you to the nearest passage in that direction, then close that passage. During your teleportation, Dark Shock manifests and attacks.

80004404.name: [Order] Rising Fate
80004404.desc: Adds 1 use of your Ascent skill.

80004405.name: [Order] Primal Fate
80004405.desc: Resets the cooldown of your Origin Skill.

80004406.name: [Order] Revolving Fate
80004406.desc: Resets the cooldown of skills up to your 5th job advancement, with some exceptions.

80004408.name: [Order] Stagnate Fate
80004408.desc: Stuns 1 enemy for 10 sec. Stun from stagnate fate stacks with Stuns from other sources.

164001000.name: Humanity: As-You-Will Fan

164001001.name: Talisman: Evil-Sealing Gourd
164001001.desc: #c[Talisman Skill]# Summons a gourd that sucks up enemies. Press the skill key a second time to launch any enemies captured by the gourd.\nCannot swallow boss monsters, stationary monsters, or enemies 11+ levels higher than you. If you wait too long after sucking up enemies, you will be unable to launch them from the gourd.

164001003.name: Graceful Flight
164001003.desc:
Leap with such grace that you could balance on a single blade of grass. Use while midair to jump. Can be used twice before touching the ground again.
When Graceful Flight is used to jump up, Nimbus Cloud's flight time is limited.
If the Nimbus Cloud lock command feature is active, it can be used with the up arrow key to move up.
The jump distance and height increase with the skill level.
164001003.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, allows you to jump a greater distance

164001004.name: Nimbus Cloud
164001004.desc:
You faced a great trial and gained the power to summon the Nimbus Cloud.
Hold down the skill key while airborne or hold down the up arrow and jump keys together to mount the Nimbus Cloud. While on the Nimbus Cloud, use the arrow keys to fly.
Flight time decreases when used after Graceful Flight up is used.
#cRight-click to lock command.#
164001004.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Temporarily gain the power to fly\nCan't use upward Graceful Flight after using Nimbus Cloud.

164001005.name: Swift Sally
164001005.desc: Swiftly charge forwards like a wind cutting through the fog and attacks enemies ahead of you.
164001005.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount while moving

164000011.name: Light Steps
164000011.desc: Harnesses mind-over-matter to make your body light and swift.

164000012.name: Shrouding Mist
164000012.desc: Protects you from enemy attacks as though you were enshrouded in mist.

164101000.name: Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave
164101000.desc:
#c[Earth Skill]# Kicks the ground to unleash a shockwave along the surface.
After casting, press the forward arrow key and the skill key again to link into Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave (True), charging forward. If you do not do this, it will link into Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave (Clone) instead.
With Action Customization enabled, link into Earth: Ground-Shattering Wave (True) by double-tapping the forward arrow key.
#cRight-click to toggle Action Customization on/off.#
164101000.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount

164101003.name: Talisman: Clone
164101003.desc: #[Talisman Skill]# Conjures a clone to trick enemies with sly attacks. For the duration of this skill, when you attack enemies, a clone will appear and attack nearby enemies.\nAttacks from installation skills or summoned minions will not create a clone. #cTalisman: Clone is unaffected by attack reflection, and targets the boss with the highest HP first.#

164100010.name: Ritual Fan Mastery

164100006.name: Out of Sight
164100006.desc: After a clone attack, hide yourself in darkness. While hidden, you cannot be hit by enemies. Using an attack skill will reveal you. Using attack skills will not reveal you (excludes class-wide skills).

164101006.name: Out of Sight
164101006.desc: After a clone attack, hide yourself in darkness. While hidden, you cannot be hit by enemies. Using an attack skill will reveal you.

164100011.name: Third Eye
164100011.desc: Opens your mind's eye, allowing you to see through the enemies' weaknesses.

164100012.name: Heavenly Body

164100012.h: Jump: +#psdJump\nIncreases the duration and flight speed for the Nimbus Cloud skill

164100013.name: Fortune Fitness
164100013.desc: Your fitness increases Luck and Final Damage.

164110014.name: Scroll Energy
164110014.desc:
Your master's spell book has taught you to use Scroll Skills.
Successful hits with your #cHeaven, Earth, and Humanity skills,# or use of #cTalisman Skills,# will earn you #Scroll Energy,# which powers your Scroll Skills.

#You can hold a maximum of 900 Scroll Energy.#

164111000.name: Heaven: Iron Fan Gale
164111000.desc:
#c[Heaven Skill]# Summons a giant fan to blow a gale downward.
#cPress the forward key and the skill key again to use Iron Fan Gale (True), leaping forward. Otherwise, this skill will link into Iron Fan Gale (Clone), sending a clone to attack.
With Action Customization enabled, link into Iron Fan Gale (True) by double-tapping the forward arrow key.
This skill's attack speed cannot be increased beyond a set value.#
#cRight-click to toggle Action Customization on/off.#

This skill shares its skill level with #cHeaven: Iron Fan Gale.#. After using Heaven: Iron Fan Gale, leaps forward to stomp on enemies.

#cIron Fan Gale (Clone) is unaffected by attack reflection.#

400010070.name: Final Beyond Blade - White Tiger
400010070.desc: The full strength of Aran's connection with Maha returns, restoring the legendary power of the Polearm Warrior. Aran's techniques harness the full might of the Black Tortoise, Vermilion Bird, Azure Dragon, along with the majestic White Tiger, completing Beyond Blade.\nBeyond Blade can be used again after Beyond Blade's 3rd hit. While using this skill, no enemy attack can knock you back.

400011003.name: Divine Echo
400011003.desc: Grants an echo of your battle prowess to a nearby party member, such that they will mirror some of your attack skills and buff skills. If the last party member who received the echo is within range, that party member will receive the echo first. If a party member approaches you while your echo is inactive, that party member receives your echo. When the party member moves beyond a certain distance from you, or when Divine Echo is deactivated, the echo is lost. At that time, any Paladin's buffs applied to that party member will also be removed. This skill cannot be used on a party member who is already echoing the skills of another Paladin. If you use the skill again while skill is active, you can select which party member will receive your echo by pressing the corresponding number key (with regard to the party UI). You cannot select yourself, a party member who is already echoing someone, or a party member who cannot receive an echo.\nA party member who is echoing can't receive a full Divine Blessing.
400011003.h:
MP Cost: MP #mpCon, Duration: #time sec., Final Damage: +#u%
#cEchoing Party Member# - Upon using an offensive skill, the affected party member mimics you for #x% of Final Damage. Buff Duration on Party Member: #y% + 1% for every #w Strength (up to 100%)
Final Damage increases by #v% when Divine Blessing is used on a party member that is echoing.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400011010.name: Demonic Frenzy
400011010.desc: Sacrifice your body to the flame to fuel your vengeance. The vengeance flows through your demonic blood, then emerges to attack the enemy. Your burning demonic blood is unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.

HP Cost: #hpRCon% of Max HP. Consumes #y HP per sec. Healing Restriction: Items and skills can only heal #w% of Max HP. Hit Damage -#s% (including the damage proportional to Max HP)
Final Damage: +#x% and can be increased up to #q% per #u% HP consumed. Your demonic blood, burning with vengeance, lingers in the area, periodically dealing #damage% damage against up to #mobCount enemies #attackCount times.

Bring down enemies with immense gravitational forces.
This skill attacks the enemy with the highest Max HP and inflicts a debuff. The debuffed enemy then attacks on your behalf by pulling in surrounding enemies or objects.
(Does not work against flying enemies, but does work on movable platforms.)
#cIf the debuffed enemy disappears#, a gravity orb appears to pull enemies and objects in its place. All attacks, except for the first attack of Law of Gravity, are unaffected by attack reflection. Using this skill again while the effect is active will cancel the effect.
400021096.h:
#cPsychic Point Cost: #ppCon#, Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Debuff Duration: #time sec
Periodically attacks up to #z enemies with #x% damage #y times and pulls them in. If there is #cno enemy to pull in#, objects will get pulled in instead.
Upon ending, it explodes to attack up to #v enemies with #w% damage #u times.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400011127.name: Light of Courage
400011127.desc: Inspire your allies and scorch your enemies with the light of unfailing courage.
400011127.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #y sec., Damage: +#z%.\n#cParty Effect#: Forms a protective shield that corresponds to #x% of your party's cumulative max HP. Protective Shield Duration: #time sec., #w% of maximum reduced every sec.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400011128.name: Light of Courage
400011128.desc: Damage is increased by the light of unfailing courage.

400011048.name: Flare Slash
400011048.desc: Unleash an explosive eruption of forged Spiritual Resin. Activates when your attack skill hits while in Falling Moon or Rising Sun stances. Cooldown is reduced when #cstance is changed# with Equinox Cycle or when #cStyx Crossing or Celestial Cleave hits#. Flare Slash is unaffected by attack reflection and cooldown reduction.
400011048.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount\nCooldown: #cooltime sec, reduced by #t sec when changing stance with Equinox Cycle and reduced by 1.5x when Styx Crossing hits.

400011121.name: Blizzard Tempest
400011121.desc:
Create a powerful blizzard that calls down the Dire Wolf's Curse upon enemies.
Hitting enemies afflicted by the Dire Wolf's Curse with direct skill attacks increases the curse's power, creating an ice shard that deals additional damage.
The Dire Wolf's Curse applies to the enemy with the highest max HP first, and ice shards ignore attack reflection.
#cRight-click to toggle the ice shard effect ON/OFF#
400011121.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, using the skill increases combos to #z and afflicts up to #mobCount enemies.
Activates an aura for #q sec after the attack, which periodically afflicts up to #w enemies with the Dire Wolf's Curse.
Reusing the skill ends the it immediately
#cDire Wolf's Curse#: lasts #x seconds, hitting afflicted enemies with direct skill attacks increases the duration up to #q2 seconds, and #cice shards# appear for additional attacks. The curse can be stacked up to #y times, increasing the ice shard attack count proportionally #v times.
#cIce Chunks#: Max Enemies Hit: #u, Damage: #u2%, Number of Attacks: #u3, Cooldown: #t sec
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400011123.name: Blizzard Tempest
400011123.desc: Cast the Dire Wolf's Curse on nearby enemies.

400011110.name: Demon Bane
400011110.desc: Erupt with overwhelming destructive force and become invincible. When used while Demon Awakening is active, the awakened force is unleashed and increases its power.\nWhen you stop holding the skill key, the force will surround you, allowing you to deal a more powerful attack. To cancel the final attack, use the skill again while holding the down arrow key.
400011110.h:
Fury Cost: #forceCon, Invincibility Duration: #t sec.
When used while Demon Awakening is active, Demon Bane Final Damage: +#s%
Attacks up to #mobCount enemies with #damage% damage #attackCount times during key-down. Max Key-Down Time: #z sec.
#cWhen you stop holding the key#, consecutively attack #w enemies with #x% damage #y time(s), increases attack time by #qx in proportion to key-down duration.
Additional Critical Rate: +#cr%, Additional Ignore Defense: +#ignoreMobpdpR% for all attacks
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400011111.name: Demon Bane
400011111.desc: Surround oneself in a force field and destroy enemies while in an invincible state.

400011112.name: Revenant
400011112.desc: Your unceasing rage warps you into a specter, wavering between life and death.\nWhile active, HP cannot drop below 1 due to damage taken, you don't suffer debilitating status conditions, and the damage you take is saved as fury. Your fury then attacks the surrounding in the form of thorns, though it will also keep you in pain, even after the skill ends.\nUsing the skill again, while its effect is active, will cancel that effect. The thorns of fury deal damage to enemies with attack ignore and attack reflection. While Revenant is active, receiving continuous damage due to the fury effect will maintain your combat state.
400011112.h:
HP Cost: #hpCRCon% of Current HP, Duration: #time sec
When using the Exceed skill, activates Thorn of Fury, which damages #y enemies with #z% damage #w time(s). Additional Ignore Defense: +#ignoreMobpdpR%, Cooldown: #v sec
Saves #cDamage Taken#, up to #q% of Max HP, as Fury, and reduces cooldown in proportion to the amount saved. Your current Fury amount decreases by #q2% periodically.
#cAfter the skill ends,# any saved Fury, plus #v2% of max HP will come back to you as damage #u time(s). This damage cannot kill you by itself.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400011129.name: Revenant
400011129.desc: Draw on the power of rage, which damages you even as it strengthens you.

400011116.name: Afterimage Shock
400011116.desc: A powerful attack creates afterimage-like shockwaves, which sweep through enemies. The afterimages' attacks are unaffected by attack reflection. Using the skill again, while its effect is active, will cancel that effect.
400011116.h: #cActive Effect#: MP Cost: #mpCon, Upon successful hits with Arm Cannon's direct attacks and Bunker Buster Explosion, this skill creates afterimages that deal #z additional attack(s) with #w% damage for #time sec. Afterimages can be created up to #y time(s). Reoccurrence Cooldown: #t sec\n#cPassive Effect#: While the active effect of Afterimage Shock's isn't active, upon successful hits with the Arm Cannon, this skill creates afterimages, which attack up to #v enemies that have not been hit with #s% damage up to #u time(s). Active and Passive Effects cannot trigger simultaneously. Reoccurrence Cooldown: #x sec\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400011118.name: Dragonflare
400011118.desc:
Call forth an ancient dragon god, and with it flame incarnate. Envelop yourself in flames to burn nearby enemies, and leave Fire Energy in your wake.
If your attack skill successfully hits, the trail of Fire Energy you leave behind will explode to deal AoE damage. Using the skill again while its effect is active will cancel that effect.

If your attack skill successfully hits when the active effect of Dragonflare isn't active, a flame orb will form to deal additional attacks. All Dragonflare attacks are unaffected by attack reflection.
#cRight-click to toggle the Flame Orb Creation on/off#.
400011118.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Deals automatic attacks to up to #mobCount surrounding enemies for #damage% damage #attackCount times periodically for #time sec.
#cFire Energy#: Maintained for #x sec. Upon detonation, the Fire Energy and surroundings near Kaiser will attack up to #q enemies for #z% damage #s time(s). Explosion Cooldown: #t sec
#cFire Orb#: #u Forms Fire Orb(s) that attack for #v% damage #s2 time(s). Re-creation Cooldown: #v2 sec
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400011134.name: Ego Weapon
400011134.desc: Send your weapon to attack enemies with a will of its own. Activated upon successful hits of the Zero character's direct attack skills. A separate cooldown is applied between Alpha and Beta. Targets and attacks the enemy with the highest max HP. Ego Weapon is unaffected by attack reflection.
400011134.h: #cAlpha#: Lazuli forms #mobCount blade(s), attacking #attackCount time(s) for #damage% damage.\n#cBeta#: Lapis forms #y Heavy Swords, unleashing #u shocks(s) for #v% damage to #z enemies\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400011135.name: Ego Weapon
400011135.desc: Send your weapon to attack enemies with a will of its own. Activated upon successful hits of the Zero character's attack skills. A separate cooldown is applied between Alpha and Beta. Ego Weapon is unaffected by attack reflection.

400011136.name: Storm
400011136.desc: All aether swords commanded by Hunting Decree sweep around you in a wild current. With Hunting Decree, gather illusions around your person in proportion to the number of swords hunting for the enemy. Storm is unaffected by attack reflection, and the skill can be used again to immediately end it.
400011136.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec. Automatically attacks up to #mobCount nearby enemies periodically, for #damage% damage, #attackCount time(s).\nUpon casting, once more than 2 aether swords have been commanded, the skill's attack count is increased by #x for each pair of aether swords beyond those first two.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400011141.name: Shield of Light
400011141.desc: Become a shield for your fellow party members. Temporarily blocks the damage and debilitating status conditions on party members inside the area, and increases your Final Damage.

400011142.name: Cosmos
400011142.desc: Unleash a swirl of a complete galaxy around you. Unaffected by attack reflection.

MP Cost: #mpCon to unleash the galaxy
#cGalaxy Unleash#: periodically deals #damage% damage #attackCount times up to #mobCount enemies for #u sec.
Attack interval decreases during Cosmic Forge
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400011143.name: Sword Illusion
400011143.desc: Final Damage increases by detonating the combo orb's power.

400011144.name: Finisher - Adrenaline Surge
400011144.desc:
Unlocks the power of pure adrenaline.
Increases the duration of Adrenal Awakening permanently, and using the skill while Adrenaline Rush or Adrenal Awakening are active releases an explosive blizzard that attacks enemies.
Can only be used once while Adrenaline Rush or Adrenal Awakening are active. Not affected by attack reflection.
[Command: #cUp, Up + Attack Key#]
#cRight-click to lock command#

400011146.desc:
Unlocks the power of pure adrenaline.
Increases the duration of Adrenal Awakening permanently, and using the skill while Adrenal Awakening is active releases an explosive blizzard that attacks enemies.
Can only be used once while Adrenal Awakening is active. Not affected by attack reflection.
[Command: #cUp, Up + Attack Key#]
#cRight-click to lock command#

400020046.desc: #c[Fusion Skill]# Evan infuses Mir with his magic during #cDragon Slam#, causing Mir to briefly grow and release a blast of elemental energy. This skill advances alongside Dragon Slam. Unaffected by attack reflection.\n\c Activates when Evan uses #cElemental Barrage# while Mir is using #cDragon Slam#.

400020051.desc: #c[Fusion Skill]# Mir immediately stops attacking and teleports to Evan, creating a vortex that deals damage to nearby enemies.\nThis skill advances alongside Dragon Slam.\n\c Activates when Evan uses #c[Return]# while Mir is using #cDragon Slam or Wyrmking's Breath.#

#cLv. 20 - Max Targets: +1
Lv. 40 - Ignore Defense: +20%#

400021000.desc: Increases your attack skills by overloading the mana flowing through you.\n#cRight-click to lock activation effect.#
400021000.h:
Consumes #x% Max MP to increase the Final Damage of all your skills (excluding some skills) by #z%. 
Consumes #t% Max HP for jobs without MP. 
Can be toggled#c on/off#.

400021001.name: DoT Punisher
400021001.desc: Summons flame orbs from another dimension to pursue enemies. The flame orbs target the boss with the highest HP first. The number of orbs you summon depends on how many damage-over-time stacks you have on enemies.
400021001.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Flame Orbs Created: #x, Damage Per Orb: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Duration: #time sec
Flame Orb Damage: #dot% damage every #dotInterval sec for #dotTime sec.
This skill summons 1 additional orb for every #y of your damage over time stack(s) on enemies in range. Up to #z Flame Orbs can be summoned in total.
When multiple orbs hit a single target, their Final Damage is reduced by #w%, starting with the second orb.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400021002.name: Frost Ark
400021002.desc: Manifest the very essence of ice and lightning into a magical structure. Each time the structure is struck by lightning, it shoots out a blast of frozen electricity, dealing ice and lightning damage to nearby enemies.
400021002.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, summons a magical structure for #time sec.\nWhen hit by lightning, the structure releases an electric shock that attacks up to #mobCount enemies #attackCount times for #damage% damage. Reactivation cooldown: #t sec.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400021003.name: Benediction
400021003.desc: Calls upon your holy power to create a consecrated space that empowers and revitalizes your allies. Benedictions do not stack.
400021003.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec., Final Damage: +#w% in the zone
Party members other than yourself periodically recover #x% of max HP/MP, clear certain statuses, and have their Attack Speed increased.
Party Member Final Damage: +1% per #q2 INT, based on the number of party members (min: #q%, max: #w%).
HP/MP Recovery: +1% per #y INT (up to #z% max)
Attack Speed: +1 per #u INT (up to +3 max)
This increase doesn't count INT granted by Special Skill Rings.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400021004.name: Orbital Inferno
400021004.desc: Hurls a giant ball of flame that shoots forward before returning to you. It disappears if you move too far. Can be used without a casting animation during Orbital Flame. This is a fire-attribute attack. \nUnaffected by attack reflection.
400021004.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Ignore Enemy Defense: #ignoreMobpdpR%\nCollision occurs up to #x times for each enemy.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400021005.name: Gate of Light
400021005.desc: Summons a gate to a realm of pure light whose blinding glow incinerates nearby. Pressing the skill key again while the Gate of Light exists summons the Gate of Light based on your current location. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400021005.h: MP Cost: #mpCon. Periodically summons a Gate of Light with Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Duration: #time sec\n#cCan only be used while Equilibrium is active#, Cooldown: #z sec.

400021006.name: Aura Scythe
400021006.desc: Combine all of your auras and become a grim specter of death. While using Aura Scythe, aura type skills cannot be used. While a Battle Mage in your party is using Aura Scythe, you cannot use aura type skills, except for Weakening Aura or Aura Scythe. When Aura Scythe ends, the aura skill that was active before Aura Scythe was used reactivates automatically.
400021006.h: MP Cost: #mpCon per sec, Duration: #time sec, grants the effect of all your auras. Additional Magic ATT increase by #indieMad for the self.\nThe Aura Scythe enhances your Blow skills. MP Cost: #q, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount. Additional Critical Rate: +#cr%, Enemy DEF Ignored: +#ignoreMobpdpR%.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400004111.desc:
Enhances Hyper Magnum Punch.

#cLv. 20 - Critical Rate: +5%
Lv. 40 - Ignore Defense: +20%#

400021012.name: Elemental Barrage
400021012.desc: Utilizes powerful elemental magic for rapid attacks. You'll get new powers for a short time after each attack. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400021012.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, uses magic 4 times in a row, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Critical Rate: +#cr%
Each element increases Final Damage by #y% for #x sec
Cooldown: #cooltime sec
Casting Elemental Barrage after a Mir skill will instead trigger a#c fusion skill#. Casting Elemental Barrage while lying down will not prevent the fusion skill from triggering. However, MP cost will be multiplied by 2.

142140504.name: Gravitation
142140504.desc: Creates otherworldly objects which are drawn to the enemy by the force of gravity. The objects target the boss with the highest HP within range first. Unaffected by attack reflection.
142140504.h: MP Cost: #mpCon. When a direct attack lands, creates an object that deals #damage% damage #attackCount times, before bouncing once to deal an additional attack\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400021016.name: Elemental Barrage
400021016.desc: Utilizes powerful elemental magic for rapid attacks. You'll get new powers for a short time after each attack.

400021028.name: Poison Nova
400021028.desc: Releases a poisonous cloud that spreads in all directions, striking nearby enemies. You can detonate the cloud to inflict additional damage. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400021028.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Creates a number of poisonous clouds that deal #damage% damage #attackCount times, and inflict an additional #dot% damage every #dotInterval sec. for #dotTime sec.

400021030.name: Bolt Barrage
400021030.desc: Summons a wall of lightning that pulses forward, electrocuting enemies in its path. Unaffected by attack reflection.

MP Cost: #mpCon
Conjure #w lightning bolts that attack up to #q enemies, dealing #v% damage #s times.

Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400021032.name: Angel of Balance
400021032.desc: Summons an angel of compassion and vengeance. Not usable while Bahamut is active. Avenging Angel is unaffected by attack reflection. Targets the boss with the highest HP first (within attack range).

MP Cost: #mpCon, Summon Duration: #time sec.
#cAngel of Benevolence#: Grants a buff that recovers #y% of party members' Max HP every #x sec. For #subTime sec., increases your damage by #damage%, and party member damage by #w% plus 1% per #attackCount INT, up to #u3%.
This increase doesn't count INT granted by special skill rings
#cAvenging Angel#: Attacks up to #s enemies dealing #z% damage #v times. Attacked enemies are marked for #q sec. Holy damage dealt to marked enemies by you and party members consumes the mark and grants the attack Final Damage +#q2%.

400021033.name: Angel of Balance
400021033.desc: Summons an angel of compassion and vengeance. Not usable while Bahamut is active. Avenging Angel is unaffected by attack reflection.

400021041.name: Aether Conduit
400021041.desc: Attack enemies in front of you by summoning a magic circle that resonates with light and darkness. While casting, you are immune to knockback, immune to debilitating status conditions, and unaffected by attack reflection. Immediately canceled if you use it again.\nEnhanced while in Equilibrium from Equalize, and enhanced skill can be used immediately regardless of cooldown. Enters cooldown after Enhanced Aether Conduit ends.\nAether Conduit is not an Equilibrium skill, but reduces Baptism of Light and Darkness cooldown.

Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400021042.name: Savage Flame
400021042.desc: Unleash the true might of the Essence of Fire. Only usable while Fires of Creation is active. Attack varies based on the Fire Essence summoned. Using it while pressing the down arrow key will activate an attack that matches a Fire Essence that isn't summoned. Triggers an attack that matches a summoned Fire Essence even when used with the down arrow key when command is locked. This is a fire-attribute attack.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.\n#cCommand Lock: Right-click#

Flames remain for #time sec, triggering explosions against up to #v3 enemies who are caught in the flames. Each explosion attacks up to #w3 enemies for #w4% damage #s3 times. Each enemy can trigger an explosion up to #s4 times.\n#c[Flame Fox]#: Maintained up to #dot sec. Creates #q foxfires that target the boss with the highest HP first and strike #q2 enemies within range. Each foxfire deals #dotInterval% damage and can regenerate #u2 times.

400021066.name: Elemental Fury

400021068.name: Crystalline Spirit
400021068.desc: Use the power of mytocrystals to form a crystalline spirit and drive your enemies away. Can activate the Reaction skill with the crystalline spirit.\nDoes not reduce the number of enemies that can be attacked when the Radiant Javelin comes into contact.\nCannot use while Wings of Glory is active.

400021151.desc: Absorbs the power of mytocrystals to automatically imitate its Reaction skill. Cannot activate while Wings of Glory is in use.

When the Reaction skill is activated, an imitation Reaction skill will automatically activate as well.
The imitation Reaction skill only has #dummyStr% of the original skill's Final Damage.
However, if the Reaction skill is a 5th skill, the imitation will have #dummyStr2% instead.

The grenade will bounce on the ground and delay detonation if it doesn't hit an enemy. Unaffected by attack reflection. If you aren't on the Jaguar, this skill is changed to #cPrimal Grenade: Spark#, firing a lower number of more powerful grenades. If using the alternate skill, the cooldown will begin upon firing the first grenade, and the skill will not benefit from cooldown reduction effects.
400031032.h:
MP Cost: #x, Deals #damage% damage upon explosion, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Number of Attacks: #attackCount.
#cNo casting action if used during Wild Arrow Blast and Wild Arrow Blast Type X.#
1 grenade is prepared every #t sec., with up to #z grenades available.
Cooldown: #cooltimeMS sec., #cPrimal Grenade: Spark# cooldown upon firing first grenade: #dummyStr sec.

400031070.name: Primal Grenade: Spark
400031070.desc: Use new Resistance technology to equip a grenade launcher that can be used in addition to a crossbow. The grenade will bounce on the ground and delay detonation if it doesn't hit an enemy after moving a certain distance. Unaffected by attack reflection. If you are on the Jaguar, this skill is changed to #cPrimal Grenade: Flash#, firing a greater number of weaker grenades. If using the alternate skill, the cooldown will begin upon firing the first grenade, and the skill will not benefit from Cooldown Reduction effects.
400031070.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, upon explosion deals Damage: #damage%, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Number of Waves: #u2.
#cNo casting action if used during Wild Arrow Blast and Wild Arrow Blast Type X.#
1 grenade is prepared every #u sec., with up to #z grenades available.
Cooldown: #t sec., #cPrimal Grenade: Flash# cooldown upon firing first grenade:: #dummyStr sec.

400031034.name: Nova Blast
400031034.desc: #c[Ancient Force]#\nConsume your entire Relic Gauge to fire a bolt of obliterating energy that pierces all. The more Relic Gauge consumed, the stronger the attack will be.
400031034.h: Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon or more required to use the skill. Consumes all energy built up in the Relic Gauge to activate an explosion #z times that deals #v% damage #w times to up to #u enemies. Invulnerable while casting.\nIf the consumed Relic Gauge exceeds certain thresholds (25%/50%/75%/100%), Final Damage will be increased by 25%/50%/75%/100%, respectively. Ignore Def +#ignoreMobpdpR%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031036.name: Ancient Tempest
400031036.desc: #c[Ancient Force]#\nUses the power of the relic to call forth an Ancient Storm to wreak havoc.\nThe summoned storm moves in search of enemies, and you can also press the skill key to manually change its direction. Unaffected by attack reflection.

Duration: #u sec, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Ancient Storm Attack Count: #attackCount
Charges the Relic Gauge by #v when attacking
Direction Change Cooldown: #x sec, Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400031067.name: Primal Tempest
400031067.desc: #c[Ancient Force]#\nUses the power of the relic to call forth a Primal Storm to wreak havoc.\nThe summoned storm moves in search of enemies, and you can also press the skill key to manually change its direction. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400031067.h:
Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon
Duration: #u sec, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Primal Storm Attack Count: #attackCount
Charges the Relic Gauge by #v when attacking
Direction Change Cooldown: #x sec, Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400031037.name: Obsidian Barrier
400031037.desc:
#c[Enchant Force]#
Project the relic's power as a shield to defend yourself and your party members.
Party members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking.
Obsidian Barrier's attack is unaffected by attack reflection.
#cDeluge Enhancement#
Grants each party member a personal protective shield.
#cBurst Enhancement#
Increases the size of the shield.
#cTorrent Enhancement#
Allows the shield to be moved.
400031037.h: Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon, Duration: #time sec, decreases damage taken from attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage by -#y%.\nThe shield will deal #damage% damage #attackCount times to up to #mobCount enemies within its radius.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031038.name: Obsidian Barrier (Deluge)
400031038.desc: #c[Enchant Force]#\nProjects the relic's power as a shield to defend yourself and your party members.\nParty members who receive the protection of this skill will receive reduced damage and will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking.
400031038.h: Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon, Duration: #time sec, Hit damage -#x% (including attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage)\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031039.name: Obsidian Barrier (Burst)
400031039.desc:
#c[Enchant Force]#
Projects the relic's power as a protective shield. While within the shield, you will receive no damage from enemies' normal attacks, and reduced damage for attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage.
Party members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking.
Enhanced by the Burst emblem to defend a wider area than normal.
400031039.h: Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon, Duration: #time sec, decreases damage taken from attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage by -#y%.\nThe shield will deal #damage% damage #attackCount times to up to #mobCount enemies within its radius.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031040.name: Obsidian Barrier (Torrent)
400031040.desc:
#c[Enchant Force]#
Projects the relic's power as a protective shield. While within the shield, you will receive no damage from enemies' normal attacks, and reduced damage for attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage.
 Party members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking. 
Enhanced by the Torrent emblem to allow the shield to be moved to another location.
400031040.h: Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon, Duration: #time sec, decreases damage taken from attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage by -#y%.\nThe shield will deal #damage% damage #attackCount times to up to #mobCount enemies within its radius.\nRedeployment Cooldown: #u sec, Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400031041.name: Obsidian Barrier
400031041.desc: #c[Enchant Force]#\nProjects the relic's power as a shield to defend yourself and your party members.\nParty members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking any enemy affected by the Ancient Curse debuff.

400031042.name: Obsidian Barrier (Burst)
400031042.desc:
#c[Enchant Force]#
Projects the relic's power as a protective shield. While within the shield, you will receive no damage from enemies' normal attacks, and reduced damage for attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage.
Party members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking any enemy affected by the Ancient Curse debuff.
Enhanced by the Burst emblem to defend a wider area than normal.

400031043.name: Obsidian Barrier (Torrent)
400031043.desc:
#c[Enchant Force]#
Projects the relic's power as a protective shield. While within the shield, you will receive no damage from enemies' normal attacks, and reduced damage for attacks that deal a fixed percent of damage.
 Party members who receive the protection of this skill will deal increased Critical Damage when attacking any enemy affected by the Ancient Curse debuff. 
Enhanced by the Torrent emblem to allow the shield to be moved to another location.

400031044.name: Royal Knights
400031044.desc: Summon the honorable Royal Knights, who protect the Ruler of the Elves. Unaffected by attack reflection. Reusing the skill will end it immediately.
400031044.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, invincible during casting and disarmament\nDuration: #time sec, up to #s knights appear when attack by Mercedes hits, each dealing #u% damage #v times, Cooldown: #t sec\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031046.name: Wild Arrow Blast Type X
400031046.desc: Use a prototype crossbow, which uses Resistance technology to maximize its firepower. Can be used while in motion. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.
400031046.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Key-down Duration: #t sec., Frontal Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Consecutive Attacks: #attackCount, Enemy DEF Ignored: #ignoreMobpdpR%\nDamage taken while the key is held, including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP: -#s5%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400031057.name: Relic Unbound
400031057.desc:
#c[Enchant Force]#
Sets up an attacking Relic by completely liberating the power of Relic. When Pathfinder's attack hits, Relic that was set up resonantes and attacks according to the emblem. Cannot be used if there is no Relic emblem.
#cDeluge Enhancement#
Sets up Relic that rapidly shoots arrows at the enemy in front.
#cBurst Enhancement#
Sets up Relic that projects arrows that explode when hit.
#cTorrent Enhancement#
Sets up several Relics that simulatenously attack the enemy in a certain range.
400031057.h:
Relic Gauge Cost: #x
#cDeluge Enhancement#: rapidly shoot arrows that periodically deal #w% damage for #y sec
#cBurst Enhancement#: shoot arrows that explode #range times periodically dealing #v% damage up to #q enemies #s times for #u sec, can shoot up to #prop arrows
#cTorrent Enhancement#: sets up to #u2 Relics that periodically attacks up to #v2 enemies with #q2% damage #s2 times for #w2 sec
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400031047.name: Relic Unbound (Deluge)
400031047.desc: #c[Enchant Force]#\nLiberates the power of the Relic, setting it up to attack enemies to the front with rapid-fire arrows. When Pathfinder's attack hits, this Relic resonates and starts to attack. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400031047.h: Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon, Duration: #time sec. Periodically shoots bursts of arrows for #q% damage each.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031049.name: Relic Unbound (Burst)
400031049.desc: #c[Enchant Force]#\nSets up an attacking Relic that projects arrows that explode when enemies are hit by completely liberating the power of Relic. When Pathfinder's attack hits, Relic that was set up resonates and starts to attack. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400031049.h: Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon, Duration: #time sec, periodically shoots arrows, Max Enemies Hit: #v, Damage: #z%, Number of Attacks: #q, Explosions: #y, Max Arrows Shot: #x\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031051.name: Relic Unbound (Torrent)
400031051.desc: #c[Enchant Force]#\nSets up several attacking Relics that periodically attack nearby enemies by completely liberating the power of Relic. When Pathfinder's attack hits, Relic that was set up resonates and starts to attack. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400031051.h: Relic Gauge Cost: #forceCon, Duration: #time sec, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Max Relics: #u\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031053.name: Silhouette Mirage
400031053.desc: Evades enemy attacks by moving fast enough to create illusory doubles of yourself.\nIllusory doubles disperse the enemy's attention to either reduce damage taken by Bow Master or inflict damage on the enemy. The time to create the illusory doubles isn't deducted when you are incapacitated. Illusory doubles are unaffected by attack reflection.\nCan be toggled #cOn/Off#.
400031053.h:
Creates up to #x illusory doubles every #u sec
When you either receive damage that is at least #y% of your Max HP or you receive damage that leads to death, 1 illusory double will disappear, reducing that damage by #q%
If you have even 1 illusory double while there is an enemy to attack nearby, #bulletCount illusory bullets will deal #damage% damage #attackCount times when using an attack skill. MP Cost: #v, Cooldown: #t sec
Cooldown: #cooltimeMS sec

400031055.name: Repeating Crossbow Cartridge
400031055.desc: Use a special cartridge that allows you to fire multiple arrows at once. Use the skill again to activate a Full Burst Shot with the same cartridge. Full Burst Shot is attracted to the targeted enemy within range and attacks the boss with the highest HP first. Successful hits with Full Burst Shot grants the Marked Target buff.
400031055.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec, Usable Cartridges: #x\n#cFull Burst Shot#: MP Cost: #y, Cartridge Used: 1, Damage: #w%, Number of Arrow Attacks: #u, Arrows Fired: #v, Ignore Defense: #ignoreMobpdpR%, Critical Rate: #cr%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031058.name: Vortex Sphere
400031058.desc: Condense powerful winds into a sphere, then launch it in a slow, straight line. A gust occurs periodically with the Vortex Sphere at the center, pulling in surrounding enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400031058.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. Creates a Vortex Sphere, which moves on a collision course with the enemy. The sphere periodically attacks up to #mobCount enemies, for #damage% damage, #attackCount times.
Decreases Vortex Sphere's speed by #y% for #time sec if a Boss Monster is attacked.
Collision occurs up to #w times for each enemy.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400031061.name: [Possess] Dragon Burst
400031061.desc: #c[Possess Skill]#\nChannel your intrinsic power through the Whispershot, then blast it forward. Can be used when not in a Possessed state, and doesn't cancel the Possessed state. Every attack of Dragon Burst can grant the Death's Blessing effect. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.
400031061.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Key-down Duration: #q sec., Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Consecutive Attacks: #attackCount, Max Attacks: #y. The effect ends immediately once all attacks have been made. Once the direction is changed, #t sec. must pass before the skill can change direction again.\nDamage taken while the key is held, including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP: -#s5%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400031062.name: Thanatos Descent
400031062.desc: Malice and death descend to the ground as you unite in spirit with Satiras the Devil Dragon. #cUse the skill again# to launch a huge burst of Malice that floods your surroundings with unavoidable death. Among the enemies hit, the Arrow of Death will prioritize the enemy with the highest max HP. Death Domain can be used while using other skills. All attacks activated by Thanatos Descent are unaffected by attack reflection.
400031062.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec., Damage: +#indieDamR%, #s2 times of the damage increase effect applied to Death Domain.
Malice created periodically increases by #y. Malice created when Whispershot skill hits increases by #x.
If your attack skill hits, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Number of Arrows of Death: #mobCount, Damage Against Normal Enemies: +#v%, Cooldown: #subTime sec.
Using the skill again ends the effect immediately, while also activating Death Domain, which attacks #z consecutive times, dealing #w2% damage to up to #q enemies. While casting Death Domain, you are invincible.
While Death Domain is active, the damage increase buff is maintained as much as Thanatos Descent's remaining duration.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400031064.name: Thanatos Descent
400031064.desc: Flood your surroundings with unavoidable death.

400031065.name: [Execute] Fatal Blitz
400031065.desc: #c[Execute Skill]#\nMove rapidly, dealing fatal consecutive blows to the front. If you defeat an enemy with [Execute] Fatal Blitz, it will #creset the cooldown of Shadow Step#. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.
400031065.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #q sec., Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Consecutive Attacks: #attackCount, Max Attacks: #x. The effect ends immediately once all attacks have been made.\nDamage taken while attacking, including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP: -#s5%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031066.name: Grip of Agony
400031066.desc: Use the enemy's death throes as an offering to summon Satiras the Devil Dragon's Hand of Agony, which ignores attack reflection.
400031066.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Summons Hand of Agony with Duration: #s sec., Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Consecutive Attacks: #attackCount\nMax Attack Activation: #v2. When all of the attack activation is consumed, the effect ends immediately.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400031069.name: Thanatos Descent
400031069.desc: Damage increases due to the afterimage of Death Domain.

400040000.h: Enemies hit by the attack are poisoned. Damage: #x%, Number of Attacks: #y, Duration: #u sec.

400041000.desc: Poison your weapon to deal damage over time to enemies.
400041000.h: Enemies hit by the attack are poisoned. Damage: #x%, Number of Attacks: #y, Duration: #u sec.

MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec. Throwing skills gain extra spread.
Triple Throw attacks in 4 extra directions, with extra projectiles dealing #u% damage on up to #dummyStr enemies
Quad Star attacks in 3 extra directions, with extra projectiles dealing #damage% damage on up to #dummyStr2 enemies
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041002.name: Shadow Assault
400041002.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Rush Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Critical Rate: +#cr%, Enemy DEF Ignored: +#ignoreMobpdpR%\nAttacks up to 4 times in the direction of your choice\nCan be used 2-4 times, with a #cooltime sec cooldown beginning after the first hit

400041006.name: Blade Storm
400041006.desc: Storm forward, slashing enemies with techniques honed at the Secret Garden. You can move while attacking, and are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.
400041006.h: MP Cost: #mpCon per attack. Attack up to #z enemies for #y% damage #w times, then deals #damage% damage to up to #mobCount enemies #attackCount times for #time sec., ignoring #ignoreMobpdpR% additional Enemy DEF\nDamage taken while the key is held, including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP: -#s5%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041007.name: Omega Blaster
400041007.desc: Fires a powerful beam of energy. Can use buff skills that increases some stats after firing. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.
400041007.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #t sec., Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Number of Attacks: #u. When key-down ends or the maximum number of attacks is reached, Omega Blaster is deployed, dealing #dummyStr2% damage #dummyStr3 times with a reduced attack interval for #t2 sec.\nWhile the key is held, damage taken (including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP): -#s5%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041008.name: Shadow Spear
400041008.desc: Shadows coalesce form a spear that pierces enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Has no effect in towns. This is a dark-attribute attack.
400041008.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time, spears form every time you use a dark attribute skill (except Shadow Spear and summons).
Spears deal #damage% damage #attackCount times. If the spears activate #dummyStr times, they form a giant spear that deals #q% damage over #y attacks. Spears can attack one enemy up to #dummyStr2 times.
All the Shadow Spear's attacks increase Damage Against Normal Monsters by #nbdR%
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041009.name: Luck of the Draw
400041009.desc: Throw a flurry of cards until you're down to your last one. Will luck be on your side as you unveil it? The cards will attack the boss monster in the area with highest max HP first. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill, and are invincible while you draw the card after the attack stops.
400041009.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. Can hold the key down for up to #time sec. Attack by periodically throwing multiple cards forward. Damage: #damage%, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Number of Attacks: #attackCount. Damage taken while the key is held, including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP: -#y%
When finished, draws a card to buff all party members for #dotInterval sec.
#cPriest -# Recovers #u% Max HP/MP over time. 
#cTree of Life -# All Damage Taken: -#v%. Abnormal Status Resistance: +#s2
#cHourglass -# Active Cooldowns shortened by #u2% (except skills that ignore cooldown resets).
#cThree Swords -# Final Damage +#v2%.
#cLuck of the Draw -# Gain all card buffs simultaneously.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041011.name: Luck of the Draw
400041011.desc: Priest: recover Max HP/MP over time.
400041011.h: #cPriest#: recover #y% of Max HP/MP over time.

400041012.name: Luck of the Draw
400041012.desc: Tree of Life: reduces damage taken, including proportional HP damage and increases Abnormal Status Resistance.
