400041013.name: Luck of the Draw
400041013.desc: Hourglass: reduces skill cooldowns (except ones not affected by cooldown resets).
400041013.h: #cHourglass#: reduces skill cooldowns by #x%, excluding skills not affected by cooldown reset

400041014.name: Luck of the Draw
400041014.desc: Sharp Sword: increases your Final Damage.

400041015.name: Luck of the Draw
400041015.desc: Throw a flurry of cards until you're down to your last one. Will luck be on your side as you unveil it? You can move slowly while attacking.
400041015.h: #cLuck of the Draw#: Grant all cards buffs simultaneously.

400041020.name: Shurrikane
400041020.desc: Throws a massive shuriken said to be used by the thieves of old. Unaffected by attack reflection. Reduced chance of activating Assassin's Mark.
400041020.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. Throwing Stars Cost: 1, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount. Damage: #damage%. Number of Attacks: #attackCount
A huge shuriken flies forward striking foes, then spins in place, dealing additional damage for #z sec before disappearing. Using the skill again while the shuriken is flying will stop it immediately at its current location.
#w% of normal chance to trigger Assassin's Mark.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041021.name: Blades of Destiny
400041021.desc: Decide the fate of your opponents with a blinding flurry of blades. Additional hit from Blade Clone is applied only once.
400041021.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Slashes: #w, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Enemy DEF Ignored: #ignoreMobpdpR%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400041022.name: Ace in the Hole
400041022.desc: Throw a razor-sharp card, infused with incredible power, that ricochets dangerously. The card will ricochet against nearby enemies several times, starting with the highest-Max-HP enemy among them. If there are no nearby enemies, the card's magic will trigger instantly. If the skill is used again when all of the throwable cards are present, the cards will gather around the enemy with the highest Max HP, from amongst enemies in front of Phantom, to release all their power at once. The released cards' attack activation count increases proportionally to the remaining attack count. If you use the skill with the down arrow key, you can release the power immediately after throwing a card. Ace in the Hole is not affected by attack reflection skills. Can be used without a casting animation during Tempest.
400041022.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, #bulletCount of cards ricochet #z times, dealing #damage% damage, before releasing the energy stored inside to strike up to #q enemies for #w% damage #v times.\nLiberated Card: activates its offensive power #dot time(s). Max Enemies Hit: #s, Damage: #y%, Number of Attacks: #u. Attacks are activated up to #q2 time(s) in proportion to the number the ricocheted cards' remaining attacks.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041025.name: Trickblade
400041025.desc: Move behind the enemy damaged by Assassinate and Sonic Blow to deal a fatal attack. Assassinate and Sonic Blow leave a wound debuff on the highest Max HP enemy that was hit. Attacks linked with Assassinate and Sonic Blow are unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.
400041025.h: #cPassive Effect#: The enemy hit with Assassinate's last attack and Sonic Blow receives a wound debuff, for #time sec, that can stack up to 3 times. Only 1 enemy can receive the wound debuff. If the debuff is given to a new enemy, the previous debuff disappears.\n#Active Effect# - MP Cost: #mpCon. Summons your hidden friends to deal #y% damage up to #v enemies #q times. Cooldown: #cooltime sec.\nIf one of the enemies has the wound debuff at max stack, you can use it by linking from Assassinate and Sonic Blow to move behind that enemy, then slashes #q2 times, dealing #w% damage #z times with Critical Rate +#cr% and ignoring #ignoreMobpdpR% additional Defense. Invincible for #t sec. after the attack, which also applies #u2 sec. of cooldown.

400041026.name: Trickblade
400041026.desc: Move behind the enemy damaged by Assassinate and Sonic Blow to deal a fatal attack. Assassinate and Sonic Blow leave a wound debuff on the highest Max HP enemy that was hit. Attacks linked with Assassinate and Sonic Blow are unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.

400041028.name: Greater Dark Servant
400041028.desc: Summon a shadow that mimics its summoner.
400041028.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Summons a shadow with Duration: #time sec.\n#cShadow#: Each Throwing Star attack deals an additional #x% of Final Damage\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041029.name: Core Overload
400041029.desc: Overloads your energy core, producing power in excess of your maximum storage capacity. Your skills will not cost any energy. Overloaded attacks produce plasma currents that strike nearby enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. The increased capacity from overloading cannot be recharged by Amaranth Generator.
400041029.h:
MP Cost: #mpRCon% of Max MP, Duration: #time sec. While active, energy charges beyond #w. Final Damage increases by #x% per Surplus Energy.
For #dummyStr sec., Damage +#dummyStr2%, Ignore Defense +#dummyStr3%
Using the skill again deactivates the effect and causes the Extra Surplus Energy to disappear immediately.
Periodically generates plasma currents that activate electricity #s times striking up to #mobCount enemies for #damage% damage #attackCount times.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041032.name: Last Resort
400041032.desc: You vow to destroy your enemies at any cost. You can renew your vow to empower its effects by using the skill again while it's active. Using the skill with the down arrow key will immediately renew your vow. With Action Customization enabled, you can renew your vow by pressing its key again, without use of the arrow keys.\n#cRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF#
400041032.h:
HP Cost: #hpCon, increases Final Damage for #time sec.
Enters 2nd Stage with remaining duration being reduced to #u% when skill is used again during 1st Stage, skill ends when used again during 2nd Stage.
1st Stage - Final Damage: +#y%
2nd Stage - Final Damage: +#q%
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.
[Passive Effect - ATT Power: +#padX]

400041033.name: Apocalypse Cannon
400041033.desc: Summons an ancient Nova weapon reforged by the Shadowdealers. The cannon draws in energy, and eventually fires. Does not trigger Attack Reflection. The cannon's amassed attack and fired projectile doesn't deactivate Dark Sight.
400041033.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Dujration: #time sec.
The cannon gathers energy for #s2 sec., periodically inflicting #damage% damage #w times to up to #x enemies at set intervals.
Amasses up to #u2 times, and increases the cannon's duration if it's not fully amassed.
Can be resummoned by pressing the skill key again.
After amassing enough energy, it creates a supernova that deals #q% damage #u times to up to #s enemies.
#cCooldown: #cooltime sec#.

400041035.name: Chain Arts: Void Strike
400041035.desc: Throws your chains with such intensity that they tear through the fabric of space and time, wreaking havoc on your foes. Can inflict damage even on enemies with attack ignore and attack reflection.\n#cRight-click to toggle the gray background ON/OFF#
400041035.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec. Creates giant chains that travel along an arbitrary path inflicting #y% damage #w times to up to #x enemies.\n#cChain Cooldown: 0.6 sec#\n#cCooldown: #cooltime sec#

400041037.name: Shadow Bite
400041037.desc: Makes your enemies' shadows attack them. If Shadow Bat and Ravenous Bat can be summoned, the bats appear and immediately attack the enemies. The bats summoned by Shadow Bat aren't enhanced. This is a dark-attribute attack. Permanently increases Final Damage.
400041037.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, deals #x% damage to bosses, creates a Shadow Bat and Ravenous Bat where an enemy was attacked #conly if a bat can be summoned#.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.\n[Passive Effect: Final Damage: +#pdR%]

400041038.name: Dark Lord's Omen
400041038.desc: Unleash the power of the Dark Lord's insight. You can detonate the scroll immediately by using the skill again. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400041038.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, shoot #bulletCount Throwing Star(s) per 1 enemy for #time sec., dealing #damage% damage to max #mobCount enemies
#x additional Throwing Stars are launched regardless of the number of enemies.
Boss Damage: +#bdR%
The scroll explodes when the skill duration ends, dealing #selfDestruction% damage with #w additional attacks. Max Enemies Hit: #z
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041039.name: Sonic Blow
400041039.desc: Move faster than the speed of sound, dealing consecutive attacks along the way. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.\nEvery attack of Sonic Blow leaves a wound debuff on the highest Max HP enemy that was hit. Sonic Blow can be canceled immediately, by either using Shadow Assault or Trickblade, while an enemy with max wound stacks is within range. Cooldown is reduced in proportion to the remaining number of attacks.
400041039.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #q sec., Damage: #damage%, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Ignore Defense: #ignoreMobpdpR%
Each Sonic Blow attack inflicts the highest Max HP enemy that was hit with #y wound debuffs.
Damage taken while the key is held, including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP: -#z%
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.
Attack can be canceled by using Trickblade if there is an enemy with max wound stacks. Reduces cooldown by #t sec. for every remaining number of attacks.

400041040.name: Phantom's Mark
400041040.desc: Teleport to a target and brand it with the Phantom Thief's Mark.\nTargets the boss with the highest max HP first.
400041040.h: MP Cost: #mpCon. Invincible for #subTime sec after moving.\nActivates #q trajectories, dealing #damage% damage #attackCount time(s), and complete the Master Thief Mark, activating #u times and dealing #s% damage #z time(s). For all attacks, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount. Additional Critical Rate: +#cr%\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041041.name: Chain Arts: Maelstrom
400041041.desc: Whip chains at high speed to create a maelstrom that will strike fear into the hearts of all your enemies.\nThere can only be 1 maelstrom, and it is unaffected by attack reflection.\nChain Arts: Can only use as a linked skill after using 2 Thrash hits. You can also use it by pressing the down key+[Attack Key].
400041041.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%\nNumber of Attacks: #attackCount, Slow Chance: #prop%, Slow Duration: #s sec

400041042.name: Blade Tornado
400041042.desc: Spin as fast as a tornado and create a black typhoon that shoots forward to damage your enemies. The typhoon is unaffected by attack reflection.
400041042.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount
At intervals, Typhoon activates whirlwind dealing Damage: #x%, Max Enemies Hit: #u, Number of Attacks: #y. Activates whirlwind up to #w times on 1 enemy.
For Spinning Attack and Typhoon, Additional Monster DEF Ignored: +#ignoreMobpdpR% 
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041044.name: Hypogram Field: Fusion
400041044.desc: Deploys the latest Hypogram Field that combines every Hypogram feature. If the area overlaps with the previously placed Hypogram Field, it's deployed after removing that Hypogram Field. Cannot deploy Hypogram Field if Hypogram Field: Fusion is already active. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400041044.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Hypogram Field Duration: #time sec.
Periodically attack up to #mobCount enemies for #damage% damage #attackCount times.
Damage inflicted by party members within the Hypogram Field is increased by #s% upon deploying the field. Power units recharged when allies evade: +1
Hypogram Field can be redeployed by using the skill again. Redeployment Cooldown: #dummyStr sec
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400041047.name: Hypogram Field: Fusion
400041047.desc: Upon deploying Hypogram Field: Fusion, increases your damage and damage of party members within the field.

400041048.name: Sage: Clone Rampage
400041048.desc: Draws out the full power of Talisman: Clone, raining a barrage of clones on enemies. Greatly increases the Attack Power and number of clones created with Talisman: Clone. While Sage: Clone Rampage is active, the clones target the boss with the highest HP first.\nCan only be used while Talisman: Clone is active. While this skill is active, Talisman: Clone's duration will not decrease.
400041048.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, For #time sec., create #v2 clone(s) when attacking, Each clone attacks for #w2% points more damage than Talisman: Clone #q2 times\nClone creation has a #t sec. cooldown\n#cCooldown: #cooltime sec.#

400041050.name: Scroll: Tiger of Songyu
400041050.desc: #[Scroll Skill]# Summons the guardian of Mt. Songyu, a giant tiger spirit. Whenever you achieve an attribute combo stage 3, the tiger gives out a mighty roar to shake heaven, earth, and your enemies.\n\n#Scroll: Tiger of Songyu is unaffected by attack reflection.#
400041050.h:
Scroll Energy Cost: #atGauge2Con, Duration: #time sec., Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount.
When you reach attribute combo stage 3, its next attack will replace the normal attack with a roar that periodically deals #y% damage #z times.
Tiger's attacks have a cooldown of #s sec.
#cCooldown: #cooltime sec#.

400041052.name: Sage: Wrath of Gods
400041052.desc:
Call upon the gods of an unknown place and time. Temporarily increases your damage, with the gods joining in after every few attacks.
#cUse the skill a second time# to summon the gods' full power in a massive attack.

#Sage: Wrath of Gods is unaffected by attack reflection, and targets the boss with the highest HP first.#
400041052.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. Duration: #time sec. Damage: +#indieDamR%
The gods strike once per #x successful attacks, hitting up to #mobCount enemies for #damage% damage #attackCount times. Cooldown: #t sec.
Using the skill again will immediately end its effects and summon the gods again at once, creating #v2 shockwave(s) and hitting up to #u enemies for #v% damage #u2 times.
You are invincible while summoning the gods. This skill negates attack ignore and attack reflection effects.
Upon summoning the gods, damage for Heaven, Earth, and Humanity skills, as well as Clone/True skills, increases by #s% for #q sec.
#cCooldown: #cooltime sec.#

400041053.name: Sage: Wrath of Gods
400041053.desc:
Call upon the gods of an unknown place and time. Temporarily increases your damage, with the gods joining in after every few attacks.
#cUse the skill a second time# to summon the gods' full power in a massive attack.

#Sage: Wrath of Gods is unaffected by attack reflection.#

400041054.name: Sage: Wrath of Gods
400041054.desc: Receive the power of gods to increase the damage of Humanity: As-You-Will Fan, Ground-Shattering Wave skills, Iron Fan Gale skills, Stone Tremor skills, Consuming Flames skills, and Humanity: Gold-Banded Cudgel.

400041061.name: Throw Blasting
400041061.desc: Throw shurikens with explosive charms attached. The charms explode after the shurikens hit, dealing additional attack to nearby enemies. Explosions are unaffected by attack reflection.
400041061.h: #cExplosive Charm#: Throws explosive-rigged shurikens at up to #v enemies, dealing #z% damage #q times.\n#cPassive Effect#: 1 explosive charm is prepared every #u sec and activates. Active and Passive Effects cannot trigger simultaneously.\n#cActive Effect#: MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec, Usable Explosive Charms: #x, uses min #s and max #w charms per attack skill, consumes throwing stars up to the number of charms used. Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041069.name: Slash Shadow Formation
400041069.desc: Team up with dark allies in a special formation to perform a joint attack. Can be used without a casting motion when used while Assassinate or Cruel Stab is in effect. Unaffected by attack reflection. Also unaffected by the effects of Shadow Partner. Use the skill again during activation to immediately call the leader.
400041069.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount. Allies appear #x times, then the leader appears. Additional DEF Ignored: #ignoreMobpdpR%\n#cLeader#: Slashes: #y, Max Enemies Hit: #u, Damage: #v%, Number of Attacks: #w\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041075.name: Haunted Edge
400041075.desc: The malevolent spirit imbued in the blade attacks the enemy on its own. Activates automatically upon using Blade Fury or Phantom Blow.\nUsing Blade Fury in conjunction with this effect will activate Haunted Edge-Asura, which creates a sharp stabbing wind. Using Phantom Blow in conjunction with this effect will activate Haunted Edge-Yaksa, which deals countless consecutive attacks in anger.\nUnaffected by attack reflection. The sharp wind created by Haunted Edge-Asura is unaffected by Mirror Image.
400041075.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Cooldown: #cooltime sec, all attacks of Haunted Edge ignores #ignoreMobpdpR% enemy defense\n#cHaunted Edge-Asura#: Max Enemies Hit: #y, Damage: #z%, Number of Attacks: #u, Max Sword Winds: #q, Sword Wind Damage: #w%, Number of Sword Wind Attacks: #v, Final Damage of sword wind reduces by #s% when one enemy is hit by several sword winds\n#cHaunted Edge-Yaksa#: Slashes: #q2, Max Enemies Hit: #u2, Damage: #v2%, Number of Attacks: #s2

400041059.name: Rapid Throw
400041059.desc: #c[Throw]#\nToss countless throwing stars at blinding speed. If you use this skill in the air, you'll hover while you toss them. Using Rapid Throw while Dark Sight is active does not deactivate Dark Sight. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.\nRapid Throw is unaffected by Shadow Momentum's inertia effect. Each throwing star is applied at most once to the throwing star skill count of Shadow Bat and Ravenous Bat. It's a dark-attribute attack, but consecutive throw attacks have higher damage even though the shadow from Shadow Spear isn't formed.
400041059.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, consecutively throw shadow throwing stars with #damage% damage #attackCount times up to #mobCount enemies for #t sec., then finish with a huge shadow throwing star that attacks up to #z enemies with #u% damage #v times
Dark Sight for #v2 sec. while skill is in use.
Tap repeatedly to increase the consecutive throwing duration up to #t2 sec.
While Shadow Spear is active, Consecutive Throw Attack Damage: +#u2% (additive)
Damage taken while attacking, including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP: -#s5%
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041055.name: Rift Break
400041055.desc: Instantly cleave through the enemy's weak points and destroy them. Using it pours every attack on the spot, and #cusing it with the down key# will teleport you several times to the farthest enemy within range to attack.\nIf you press the directional key when you attack as you teleport, you will move to the enemy in the relevant direction first. If you use the skill again after moving, you will either stop in that place and the cooldown is reduced as much as the remaining teleports or you need to attack at least once to stop. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400041055.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Max Slashes or Teleports: #x\nCooldown: #cooltime sec, cooldown is reduced by #t sec per remaining teleports

400041057.name: Photon Ray
400041057.desc:
Lock onto enemies and destroy them with photonic cannon blasts.
Upon using the skill, #ctemporarily enter aim mode# and ready a chain of attacks, aiming several shots in sequence. Using the skill again will fire the photonic cannon at the most recently targeted enemy.
The initial fixed number of shots ends quickly. Additional shots, with a slow-moving cursor, produce one blast each. All shots prioritize Boss Monsters with the highest Max HP within range of the aim. #cAttacking an enemy that is being aimed at# ends the aiming process quickly.
The aiming process is canceled if you either move away while aiming or move away from the last targeted enemy. If the aiming process ends before firing, every shot is canceled.
Unaffected by attack reflection. Manifest Projector does not apply to this skill. Can be fired without a firing motion while using Mecha Purge, Orbital Cataclysm, or Omega Blaster.
400041057.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. Aim mode activates for #time sec. Additional #u MP consumed upon firing.
Initial shots are #v blast each. Can take up to #y additional shots after #x shots.
Photonic cannon attacks #v times with #u2% damage per shot.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400041074.name: Muscle Memory Finale
400041074.desc: Push the limits of weapon mastery to inflict additional hits with even greater power. Unaffected by attack reflection and doesn't deactivate Dark Sight. Preparation time is reduced when a specific attack skill hits.
400041074.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, activates in location of nearby enemy upon hitting Muscle Memory additional hit #w times
Additional Hit Activation: #s, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount
Muscle Memory Finale is prepared 1 each per #x sec up to #y
Preparation time reduces by #subTime sec when Chain Arts: Reign of Chains/Chain Arts: Beatdown/Chain Arts: Crush hits, reduces by #z sec when Chain Arts: Void Strike hits

400041063.name: Sage: Three Paths Apparition
400041063.desc: Through enlightenment, create a special clone capable of attribute combos. Excluding Clone/True skills, when Hoyoung's skills that attack directly hit, a clone appears and does an attribute attack for a combo that hasn't been currently done to finish the attribute combo. The clone's attacks cannot have their Final Damage increased by Scroll Energy.\nResets cooldown of one attribute skill among Heaven, Earth, and Humanity skills upon #creaching stage 3 attribute combo# while active effect is active. Prioritizes attribute with skill on cooldown upon selecting attribute.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.
400041063.h: #cPassive Effect#: clones appears to attack up to #w enemies with #u% damage #v times, cooldown: #q sec\n#cActive Effect#: MP Cost: #mpCon, passive effect can activate #y times without cooldown for #time sec, then cooldown of #v2 sec applied afterwards, #cCooldown: #cooltime sec#

400041067.name: Sage: Three Paths Apparition
400041067.desc: Waiting to create a special clone that will realize parts of the inner workings of your techniques.

400041082.name: Hex: Pandemonium
400041082.desc: Spreads the realm of chaos. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400041082.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec, Summons the realm of chaos, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount
Attack Speed increases in proportion to the realm of chaos duration, and can increase up to +3.
When duration ends, Max Enemies Hit: #u, Damage: #v%, Number of Attacks: #w, Number of Explosions: #u2
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400041084.name: Void Burst
400041084.desc: #c[Void]#\nDescends as the Wind of Vengeance and annihilates all enemies that are grazed, even afterimages. Temporarily gain invincibility. Using the skill again will pursue one target within range to deal consecutive attacks several times. When either the consecutive attack or the duration ends, a powerful finishing attack will be dealt. The consecutive attacks and finishing attack of Void Burst manifest Chakri. Consecutive attacks target the boss with the highest HP first. If there is no target, it will trigger with the caster as the target.
400041084.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Wind of Vengeance Descent Duration: #t sec, Invincible during Wind of Vengeance
Using the skill again during Wind of Vengeance pursues a target in the surroundings, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Consecutive Attacks: #attackCount
#y consecutive attacks or duration ends, Max Enemies Hit: #u, Damage: #v%, Number of Attacks: #w, Slashes: #q, Invincibility Duration: 3.5 sec
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400041087.name: Arts: Astra
400041087.desc: Summons an ancient chakram. Activates automatically when Arts skills hit. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400041087.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Ancient Chakram Summoned: #x\nDisappears after a while, Max Enemies Hit: #u2, Damage: #v2%, Number of Attacks: #w2\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400041089.name: Resonate: Ultimatum
400041089.desc: Maximizes the inherent magic power to awaken Summon Chakri and Resonate. Targets the boss with the highest HP first. Unaffected by attack reflection.

Max Awakened Chakri Created: #x

Normal Enemy Damage: + #w% points
When repeatedly hitting a single target, Final Damage: -#w2%

400041092.name: Omega Blaster
400041092.desc: Fires a powerful beam of energy. Can use buff skills that increases some stats after firing.

400051000.name: Loaded Dice
400051000.desc: The next time you use Roll of the Dice, you get to throw an extra die and choose your desired number (via the number keys). Jobs without Roll of the Dice will be allowed to use the Roll of the Dice skill and choose their desired number.

HP Cost: #hpCon, select your desired die roll.
If a job that has Double Down gets the same number on 2 dice, the chance for the last die to have the same number is decreased by #x%.
Cooldown: #cooltime Sec.
[Passive Effect: Attack Power: +#padX]

400051001.name: Roll of the Dice
400051001.desc: Test your luck! Roll dice to get a random Buff. Roll a 1 and you get nothing, but Roll of the Dice's cooldown will be reduced by 50%.

HP Cost: #hpCon, Dice Buff Duration: #time sec
1: Roll of the Dice Cooldown: -50%
2: Defense +#pddR%
3: Attack Power +#s
4: Critical Rate: +#cr%
5: Damage +#damR%
6: EXP Obtained +#expR%
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051002.name: Lightning Form
400051002.desc: Receive the power of the seas and soar to new heights. Double-tap an arrow key to teleport in that direction. Use the skill again to attack nearby enemies with a huge orb of energy. The orb of energy is unaffected by attack reflection. You are invincible while creating the orb. When the command is locked, double-tapping the movement keys will not teleport you.\n#cRight-click to lock command#
400051002.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Duration: #time sec., Final Damage: +#indiePMdR%.
Can use up to #w energy orbs
Energy orbs will periodically deal #damage% damage #attackCount times on up to #mobCount enemies, 1 orb can attack a single enemy up to #s times
Critical Rate: +#cr%, Ignore Defense: +#ignoreMobpdpR%
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051006.name: Bullet Barrage
400051006.desc: Wildly fire your gun in all directions. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill. Reuse the skill to immediately cancel it. While using Bullet Barrage, you cannot glide with Wings or use Wings in the air.
400051006.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. Duration: #time sec. Periodically deal #damage% damage, #attackCount times, on up to #mobCount enemies.
Can only attack up to #u times on single enemy.
Can move and jump while using the skill. Damage taken while attacking, including attacks that deal damage in proportion to Max HP: -#s5%. This skill will be immediately canceled if you use it again.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051007.name: Lightning Cascade
400051007.desc: Call upon the full power of the storm to annihilate your enemies with a chain of lightning. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400051007.h:
#cActive Effect#: MP Cost: #mpCon. Grants Final Damage +#indiePMdR% for #time sec. Initial Damage: #damage%, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Number of Attacks: #attackCount. Send forth a lightning bolt. 
The damage it deals decreases with each enemy it attacks, and it can hit up to #x nearby enemies in a row.
When only one bolt triggers, it becomes a more powerful version, dealing #s% damage #q times.
Lightning Spawn Cooldown: #y sec.
#cPassive Effect#: when you attack when the active effect of Lightning Cascade isn't active, 1 lightning bolt activates if there are normal enemies nearby. Cooldown:#z sec. Active and Passive Effects cannot trigger simultaneously.
Skill Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051008.name: Cannon of Mass Destruction
400051008.desc: Fire a gigantic rocket from your cannon. Unaffected by attack reflection. Use with the down arrow key to fire all the rockets at once.\nIn speed reduction mode, the flying speed is halved when the rocket collides with the enemy.\n#cRight-click to toggle speed reduction mode ON/OFF.#
400051008.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. Periodically fire a giant rocket. Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount. Damage: #damage%. Number of Attacks: #attackCount
Only up to #w hits can occur against a single enemy.
You can prepare a rocket once every #q seconds, and can hold up to #y at a time.
The giant rocket can benefit from cooldown reduction effects.
Cooldown: #cooltimeMS sec.

400051009.name: Doomsday Device
400051009.desc: Summons an diabolical death machine to annihilate your opponents. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400051009.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, summoned machine lasts #time sec and arsenal includes Gatling Guns and missiles
#cGatling Gun# - Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Cooldown: #t sec
#cMissiles# - Fires 2 missiles to hit up to #q enemies, Damage: #w%, Number of Attacks: #v, Cooldown: #s2 sec
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400051010.name: Fox God Flash
400051010.desc: Incarnates an Avatar of the Fox God, vanquishing darkness with divine light.\nBlessed by the Fox God, Shade's skill cooldowns reset, excluding skills that are not affected by cooldown reset effects.\nThe Avatar of the Fox God enhances Shade's blessing for a set duration, and Foxlight shines down to scour enemies hit by Shade's attacks. Foxlights are not affected by attack reflection.

MP Cost: #mpCon
Increases Final Damage by #indiePMdR% for #time seconds, recovers #y% of max HP every #x seconds
Foxlights activate regularly for #v3 seconds while the buff lasts.
Once every #v seconds, landing an attack will increase the Foxlight activation time by #v2 seconds. Foxlights won't activate once their duration expires, even if the buff is ongoing.
#cFoxlight#: Max Enemies Hit: #q2, Damage: #q3%, Number of Attacks: #q4
Can be activated up to #u times
Skill ends immediately upon recast or using up all remaining Foxlight
to activate an attack with Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Number of Waves: #s.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051100.name: Fox God Flash
400051100.desc: Incarnates an Avatar of the Fox God, vanquishing darkness with divine light.\nBlessed by the Fox God, Shade's skill cooldowns reset, excluding skills that are not affected by cooldown reset effects.\nThe Avatar of the Fox God enhances Shade's blessing for a set duration, and Foxlight shines down to scour enemies hit by Shade's attacks. Foxlights are not affected by attack reflection.

400051011.name: Sparkle Burst
400051011.desc: Gathers the love of all for the idol of the battlefield, amplifying the energy of the relic and detonating it.\nAfterward, the power of love hangs in the air and temporarily negates all damage. Sparkle Burst is unaffected by attack reflection.
400051011.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount Love Explosions: #v\nInvincible for #z sec after #time sec or when using the skill is used again.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400051098.name: Sparkle Burst
400051098.desc: The masses' collective love of the Battleground Idol temporarily nullifies all damage.

400051013.name: Lightning Cascade
400051013.desc: Call upon the full power of the storm to annihilate your enemies with a chain of lightning. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400051013.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, send forth a traveling lightning bolt that lasts for #time sec, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount\nThe damage it deals decreases with each enemy it attacks, and you can trigger up to #x bolts per #y sec depending on the number of enemies nearby\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400051015.name: Lord of the Deep
400051015.desc: Call upon the spirit of the dreaded sea serpent that slumbers beneath the savage tides to wrap yourself in a deadly barrier that maims all foes who venture near. Unaffected by attack reflection.\nCan attack a certain number of times when activated. Both the number of attacks and cooldown are automatically refreshed when cooldown ends while active. Using the skill again ends it immediately and reduces cooldown in proportion to the remaining number of hits.\nCan be toggled #cOn/Off#.
400051015.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon. When activated, can attack #v times. When attacking boss monsters, counts 1 time while attacking #q times.
Automatically attacks up to #mobCount nearby enemies periodically, for #damage% damage, #attackCount time(s).
Reduces cooldown by #y sec. for every #w2 normal enemies defeated. When skill ends, reduces cooldown by #x sec. for every #u remaining number of attacks.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051016.name: Shark Torpedo
400051016.desc: #c[Link Mastery Skill]#\nSummons a deadly shark spirit that flies forward, attacking your foes. Can be linked with all skills except for Thunder and itself. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400051016.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Consumes #x Lightning Charges.
Fires a deadly spirit-shark that deals #damage% damage #attackCount times to up to #mobCount enemies.
When Lightning Charge is at max stacks, Damage: +#u% points
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400051017.name: Mobile Missile Battery
400051017.desc: Launches a missile battery that fires a barrage of micro-missiles. The micro-missiles target the boss with the highest HP first.
400051017.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, Launches a battery that fires #bulletCount micro missiles at up to #mobCount enemies.\nMicro missiles deal #damage% damage #attackCount times.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400051018.name: Superstar Spotlight
400051018.desc: A real superstar brings their own spotlight everywhere they go. Enemies take damage under its rays because they are unworthy of the spotlight. Your own abilities are boosted while you bask in the glow. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400051018.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Install 3 spotlights that shine on you for #time sec
While you are within the spotlight, you gain Status Resistance +#w, Critical Rate +#v%, and Final Damage +#s%.
Each spotlight deals #damage% damage #attackCount times against up to #mobCount enemies within its area.
Each subsequent spotlight to hit the same enemy deals #u3% less Final Damage.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400051021.name: Target Lock
400051021.desc: Locks onto your targets, then draws your gun and fires upon them in rapid succession. Aims at the boss with the highest Max HP within a certain range. If you're already aimed at the max number of enemies that can be attacked, and a high priority enemy appears within range, the aim on the farthest enemy is released and the high priority enemy is aimed onto. Invincible while casting.
400051021.h:
#c[Passive Effect]# Focuses aim on up to #mobCount enemies within range whenever skill is not in cooldown.
#[Active Effect]# MP Cost: #mpCon, Targeted enemies take #damage% damage #attackCount times, at +#cr% Critical Rate.
Deals extra damage for Target Locks. Bonus stacks up to 3x.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400051022.name: Spiritgate
400051022.desc: Throws open a gate to the spirit world with an explosion of energy, followed by Spirits of Darkness that spill out and attack your foes.\nSpiritgate is not affected by attack reflection, and the Spirits of Darkness target the boss with the highest HP within range first.
400051022.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon
Opens the Spiritgate. Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Energy Explosion Count: #q2. Enemies hit by the energy are afflicted by a debuff for #x seconds.
Attacking an enemy afflicted with the debuff increases Critical Damage by #y%.
Afterwards, #w4 Spirits of Darkness appear to pursue and attack enemies.
#cSpirit of Darkness#: Damage: #w2%, Number of Attacks: #w3
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051024.name: The Nuclear Option
400051024.desc: Fire a ballistic missile along a curved trajectory to obliterate enemies in a wide range. Targets the boss with the highest HP within range first. Unaffected by attack reflection.
400051024.h: MP Cost: #mpCon. One explosion occurs that periodically inflicts #q% damage #q2 times to up to #u enemies for #range sec.\nCreates a patch of Polluted Area lasting #u2 sec on the lowest platform within attack range which inflicts #z% damage to up to #v2 enemies.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400051027.name: Superstar Spotlight
400051027.desc: Sets up a series of mobile spotlights that empower superstars and damage enemies.

400051033.name: Overdrive
400051033.desc: Puts your weapon into overdrive to unleash more attack power. Afterwards, your weapon will be less effective for a short while and cannot be unequipped until it's back to normal.
400051033.h: HP Cost: #hpCon, Duration: #time sec, Attack Power: +#x% of base weapon attack power, Attack Power during cooldown: -#y% of base weapon attack power\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

400051035.name: Abyssal Recall
400051035.desc: Connects you directly to the source of Abyssal power to temporarily prevent consuming Spectra in your Specter State.

400051036.name: Infinity Spell
400051036.desc: Exchange your HP for unlimited magical power. The additional Abyssal Aura created with Infinity Spell targets the boss with the highest HP first among the targets that were attacked.
400051036.h:
HP Cost: #hpRCon% of Max HP
Duration: #time sec
#cFlora State#: When spell is charged, Basic Cast is charged as much as the remaining max spell charge limit.
#cSpecter State#: When Impending Death activates, an additional #x Abyssal Auras are created
Cooldown: #cooltime sec

400051038.name: Monkey Business
400051038.desc: Summon the special Champion Monkey Platoon that will help you in battle. The platoon is comprised of 3 members, Basic Roy, Speedy Maxi, and Explosive Khakee, and is unaffected by attack reflection.
400051038.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Summon the Champion Monkey Platoon that fires Monkey Bombs and Monkey Cannons for #time sec.
Monkey Cannon: Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Attack Count: #attackCount
Monkey Bomb: Max Enemies Hit: #s, Damage: #y%, Attack Count: #w, Additional Monster DEF Ignored: #ignoreMobpdpR%
#cBasic Roy#: Uses Monkey Cannon every 1 sec., and Monkey Bomb every #x sec.
#cSpeedy Maxi#: Uses Monkey Cannon every 0.7 sec., and Monkey Bomb every 20 sec.
#cExplosive Khakkee#: Uses Monkey Cannon every 2.5 sec., and Monkey Bomb every 3 sec.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051040.name: Nautilus Assault
400051040.desc: The Battleship Nautilus charges forward at its enemies. Strike enemies with the ship to create a weak spot, then fire all cannons to annihilate them. Unaffected by attack reflection.\nCannot be used when #cNautilus Strike# is being used.
400051040.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Invincible while casting
#cShip Attack#: The ship attacks at set intervals. Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Ship Attack Activation Count: #q
#cVolley#: Fires a volley at set intervals. Damage: #y%, Number of Attacks: #x, Volley Activation Count: #s
Cooldown: #cooltime sec
When either #cNautilus Strike# or #cNautilus Assault# is used, a cooldown of #w sec is applied, but it won't be applied if another cooldown longer than that time is already applied.

400051041.name: Full Metal Barrage
400051041.desc: Use all available Mech weapons to fire every single one of your bullets at once. Invincible while casting, but cannot move or change direction.\nCan use a more powerful Homing Beacon while casting. Can also use buff skills that increase some stats after casting.

Final Damage: +#u%.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051042.name: Serpent Vortex
400051042.desc:
Erupt with the force of the ocean as you charge forward.
Use an arrow key with the skill to charge in up to 6 different directions except for upwards and downwards.
While in #cSerpent Fury Mode#, erupt all of your force of the ocean with one use.
#cRight-click to toggle Serpent Fury Mode On/Off#

Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, damage increased by #bdR% when attacking a boss

400051043.desc: Through unity, the wind spirit takes its true form.

400051044.desc:

The spear of the Thunder God appears and attacks nearby enemies. Can be linked with all skills except for itself, and is unaffected by attack reflection.
Turn on Auto Mode to automatically activate Lightning God Spear Strike whenever it is not on cooldown.

Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount

400051046.name: Mighty Mascot
400051046.desc: Eskalade that became a mascot unleashes his true power to carry out a powerful joint attack with Angelic Buster. While casting, you are immune to knockback, immune to debilitating status conditions, and unaffected by attack reflection.

400051047.name: Devious Nightmare
400051047.desc: A specter's energy that slips out during battle and attacks enemies. Enhanced to Devious Dream during Specter State.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.

400051048.name: Devious Dream
400051048.desc: A specter's energy that slips out during battle and attacks enemies. Changed to Nightmare's Escape during Flora State.\nUnaffected by attack reflection.

400051334.name: Abyssal Recall
400051334.desc: You recall the moment your consciousness accessed the Abyssal source of power.\nUsing this skill shifts you into Specter State, and prevents consuming Spectra for skills. However, this can't be used if your Spectra has already been depleted.\nUse the skill again while the skill is cast to cancel the attack immediately. You can deal damage to enemies with Attack Ignore or Attack Reflection, but Impending Death will not activate.
400051334.h:
You link with the Abyssal Source the moment the skill is activated. You don't consume Spectra for #time sec. while in Specter State.
While the gate to the Abyssal is open, Max Enemies Hit: #mobCount, Damage: #damage%, Number of Attacks: #attackCount, Invincible while attacking
When attack ends, Max Enemies Hit: #q, Damage: #q2%, Number of Attacks: #s, Number of Explosions: #u2, recovers #w% of Max HP upon landing an explosion.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051070.name: Howling Fist
400051070.desc: Strike with all the force of a raging leviathan. You invincible while striking after collecting force, and are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill. Can strike immediately by using the skill again while collecting force.
400051070.h:
MP Cost: #mpCon
By collecting power, periodically attack up to #mobCount enemies, for #damage% damage, #attackCount time(s)
The strike will activate a series of additional shocks, attacking #w enemies, for #x% damage, #y time(s) per shock. #s shock(s) will occur in total.

400051071.name: Howling Fist
400051071.desc: Strike with all the force of a raging leviathan. Invincible while striking after collecting force. Can strike immediately by using the skill again while collecting force.

400051073.name: Death Trigger
400051073.desc:
Fire a volley of penetrating, pinpoint-accurate shots. If there are still enemies in range after the initial volley, your shots will ricochet toward them.\nIf there is only one enemy to attack, then after attacking that enemy, the shots will ricochet and attack again.
\nIf there's an enemy with Parrotargetting applied, the whole volley will target that enemy first, then attack them again during the ricochet. Ricocheting shots are unaffected by attack reflection.
400051073.h: MP Cost: #mpCon. Fires up to #bulletCount shots, which attack up to #mobCount enemies for #damage% damage #attackCount time(s).\nCooldown: #cooltime sec. Cooldown decreases by #t sec. for each remaining ricochet.

400051074.name: Poolmaker
400051074.desc: Bombards the earth with meteoric strikes. After a short delay, those strikes hit enemies near the Cannoneer, prioritizing boss monsters, enemies with the highest HP, and enemies that have survived previous strikes, in that order. Supplies will drop to support you and your party members during the first bombardment.\nIf there are no platforms for the strikes to fall onto, or if you're hanging on a rope or ladder, supplies will not drop. If the cooldown is reset while there are still strikes in reserve, the skill will end.\nStrikes are unaffected by attack reflection. To pick up the supplies, go near them and press the Up arrow key.

MP Cost: #mpCon, Damage +#s3% for #s2 sec.
Strikes that attack up to #z enemies for #u% damage, #v time(s), occur #y time(s) each.
#cSupply on first bombardment:# Duration: #q sec. Number of Supplies: #s. When used, you'll gain a +#v2% damage increase buff with a duration of #u2 sec. after recovering #q2% of max HP.
If a Cannoneer with the buff uses the supply, only the HP recovery will be applied.
Cooldown: #cooltime sec.

400051076.name: Poolmaker
400051076.desc: Damage increases in proportion to the number of supplies.

400051077.name: Poolmaker

400051058.name: Lightning Spear Multistrike
400051058.desc: Strike with a cascade of lightning that deals linked attacks. Can activate a linked attack by continuing to use the skill. Lightning is unaffected by attack reflection.

#cFinal Combo# attacks up to #u enemies, for #q% damage, #v times. When hit, activates large lightning bolts #s2 times, attacking up to #u2 enemies for #q2% damage #v2 times.

400051078.name: Smashing Multipunch
400051078.desc: Incarnate the Fox God's wrath to deliver divine fury unto your foes. You are immune to knockback and debilitating abnormal statuses while casting the skill.

400051068.name: Mecha Carrier
400051068.desc: Summon an aerial carrier, the pinnacle of Resistance technology. Carrier-based aircraft strafe nearby enemies, then return. The aircraft target the boss with the highest Max HP first.\nIf the aircraft stray too far from the Mechanic, they will move closer immediately. These aircraft are unaffected by attack reflection.

#c Carrier-Based Aircraft#: Attacks the target #v time(s) with #u% damage, then returns.

400051072.name: Trinity Fusion
400051072.desc:
Summon spotlights and dazzle your enemies with your stage presence.
This skill can be activated while Trinity and Celestial Roar is in use.
Cannot be pushed back when casting, and any damage taken will be reduced. Trinity Fusion is unaffected by attack reflection, and upon a successful hit, will apply any stacked damage increase and/or Ignore Enemy Defense.
When Action Customization is enabled, use Trinity with the Down key to activate.
#cRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF#

400051080.name: Endlessly Starving Beast
400051080.desc: Summon a ravenous beast from the Abyssal depths and command it to devour everything in its path. From the moment the depths open, there's a certain delay until the beast arrives, but successful use of Specter's Force skills can hasten its arrival. The Endlessly Starving Beast is unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.

Dusk's cooldown cannot be reduced.
When #cShadow Partner, Mirror Image, Buckshot, Falling Moon, Equinox Cycle, Dark Servant, Arc Charger, Blue Blood, or Manifest Projector# are active, your final damage will be increased instead of your attack count.

Summon a Cyclic Ring that endlessly creates and destroys Sol Erda. The cycling Erda Flow attacks nearby enemies.
When a new ring is summoned, the Erda Flow of each ring is reduced. Cyclic rings can be summoned in midair but can't be summoned too close to or too far from an existing ring. #cCannot be used in some non-hunting maps#.
Cyclic Rings are unaffected by attack reflection.
When #cShadow Partner, Mirror Image, Buckshot, Falling Moon, Equinox Cycle, Dark Servant, Arc Charger, Blue Blood, or Manifest Projector# are active, your final damage will be increased instead of your attack count.

500061000.name: Divine Echo
500061000.desc: Grants an echo of your battle prowess to a nearby party member, such that they will mirror some of your attack skills and buff skills. If the last party member who received the echo is within range, that party member will receive the echo first. If a party member approaches you while your echo is inactive, that party member receives your echo. When the party member moves beyond a certain distance from you, or when Divine Echo is deactivated, the echo is lost. At that time, any Paladin's buffs applied to that party member will also be removed. This skill cannot be used on a party member who is already echoing the skills of another Paladin. If you use the skill again while skill is active, you can select which party member will receive your echo by pressing the corresponding number key (with regard to the party UI). You cannot select yourself, a party member who is already echoing someone, or a party member who cannot receive an echo.
500061000.h: MP Cost: MP #mpCon, Duration: #time sec., Final Damage: +#u%\n#cEchoing Party Member# - Upon using an offensive skill, the affected party member mimics you for #x% of Final Damage. Buff Duration on Party Member: #y% + 1% for every #w Strength (up to 100%)\nCooldown: #cooltime sec.

80011006.name: ホーンテイルのファイヤーブレス

80011007.name: レックスの突撃

80011008.name: アニのジャッジメント

80011009.name: ドラゴンライダーのエネルギーブレス

80013282.name: Black Box
80013282.desc: #c[Level 2]# A nigh-indestructible data archive. What's inside? There's one way to find out...but it might cost you.
80013282.h: Immediately upon obtaining, you will receive #x random programs, and have #y of your owned programs removed at random. (Re-activates upon obtaining it again.)

80013283.name: Overheated Head
80013283.desc: #c[Level 3]# A computing device that performs endless calculations...even if sometimes it loses data through overheating.
80013283.h: Obtain #x Bytes when you enter a floor\n#prop% chance to delete 1 owned program. WARNING: You're included in the programs that can be deleted.

80013284.name: Creaking Limb
80013284.desc: #c[Level 3]# Waiting for repair... Repair Schedule: Unknown. Waiting for repair... Repair Schedule: Unknown. Waiting for repair...

80013285.name: Broken Heart
80013285.desc: #c[Level 3]# A heart that's been shattered and welded back together time and again. And yet, somehow it keeps on beating.

80013286.name: Overclocked Fusion
80013286.desc: #c[Level 1]# The result of three unstable programs melding into one. Once fused, they cannot be separated again.
80013286.h: Damage Taken: -#x%, Final Damage: +#z%\nNumber of Bytes Upon Obtaining: #w

80013287.name: Empty Bottle
80013287.desc: #c[Level 1]# A bog-standard empty bottle. It can be filled with anything! WARNING: Empty bottles should only be filled with things that can fit in empty bottles.

80013288.name: Debuggy
80013288.desc: #c[Level 1]# A helpful program that catches and devours bugs. It can even use all of its power to consume errors! Debuggy disappears when full.
80013288.h: Upon death, you are revived at 100% HP\nDebuggy disappears after it has been activated.

80013289.name: Rubber Duck
80013289.desc: #c[Level 3]# After extensive analysis...this seems to be a Rubber Duck.

80013290.name: Return Protocol
80013290.desc: #c[Level 1]# A safety protocol that calls an immediate end to training. Consider it a...'strategic retreat.'
80013290.h: When used, allows you to immediately bypass the Break Map and exit the dungeon.\nAll rewards can be claimed. Disappears after use.

80013291.name: Hardship Adjustment - Drop Rate
80013291.desc: Additional compensation given for increased hardships.

80013292.name: Dummy Mapae
80013292.desc: #c[Level 2]# Once activated, you have approximately 5 seconds until the enemy realizes that it's plastic.
80013292.h: Enemies hit are stunned for #time sec\nCan by applied to 15 enemies, including bosses\nIs consumed upon use.

80013293.name: Garbage Collection
80013293.h: Invincible for #time sec\nIs consumed upon use.

80013294.name: Desynced Timer
80013294.desc: #c[Level 2]# A timer whose measurements are always a little off. Fortunately, it's always in your favor.
80013294.h: Resets cooldown of 5th Job skills and below.\nConsumes 1 each time it's used.

80013295.name: Bug: Clogged Fan
80013295.desc: #c[Level 3]# #cError - Error - Error#\nAttack Data Contaminated - Cause: Fuzzball.\nNo matter how hard you hit it, it only lets out a small puff.

80013296.name: Bug: Glass Slippers
80013296.desc: #c[Level 3]# #cError - Error - Error#\nMovement Data Crash - Cause: Glass Slippers.\nWhy don't they fit???

80013297.name: Bug: Empty Battery
80013297.desc: #c[Level 3]# #cError - Error - Error#\nInsufficient Memory - Cause: Empty Battery.\nWhere did all your data go?

80013298.name: Bug: Goose Egg
80013298.desc: #c[Level 3]# #cError - Error - Error#\nData Leak - Cause: Goose Egg.\nSome geese lay golden eggs. Others just eat your Bytes!

80013299.name: Bug: Blue Pill
80013299.desc: #c[Level 3]# #cError - Error - Error#\nData Corruption - Cause: Blue Pill.\nI'm choosing to believe there were two choices.
80013299.h: The number of programs you can choose from is decreased by #x.

12141505.name: Ignis Requiem
12141505.desc: Annihilates enemies with a blazing flame ignited by the fires of creation. This is a fire-attribute attack.
12141505.h: MP Cost: #mpCon, ignites #dummyStr blazing flames, dealing #damage% damage to up to #mobCount enemies #attackCount times. Then focuses the fires of creation to trigger #dummyStr4 flame explosions, dealing #dummyStr2% damage #dummyStr3 times.\nCooldown: #cooltime sec

80013309.name: Protective Shield
80013309.desc: Obtain Protective Shield with #x% of Max HP upon starting

80013310.name: Blood for Blood
80013310.desc: Damage Taken +20% when HP is 50% or higher\nDamage Dealt +20% when HP is 50% or lower

80013313.name: Hardship Adjustment
80013313.desc: Unusually harsh environment detected. Increasing reward coefficient.
80013313.h: On this floor, Item Drop Rate: +5%, EXP Obtained: +#indieExp%

80013314.name: Hardship Adjustment
80013314.desc: Unusually harsh environment detected. Increasing reward coefficient.
80013314.h: On this floor, Item Drop Rate: +10%, EXP Obtained: +#indieExp%

80013315.name: Fortune Teller's Charm
80013315.desc: A charm from a fortune teller. Holding it makes you feel stronger.

80013271.name: Emergency Patch
80013271.desc: A program that quickly recovers data damaged in training. No side effects have been reported.

80013316.name: Dependency Injection - Drop Rate
80013316.desc: The dart landed on a lucky space.

80010581.name: Mapae's Blessing
80010581.desc: With an inspector's training, the mapae can be harnessed to great effect.\r\nProtects you from fatal blows up to 2 times.\r\nCount resets when the emergency escape protocol is activated.

80013213.name: [Hologram] Critical Damage Enhancement
80013213.desc: Links the holographic simulation to your combat system. Deduces optimizations for attacks through combat data collected in real time.\n\n#cCan be stacked up to Lv. 3 as an equipment skill. A prismatic jewel will be required from Lv. 4 onwards.

80013214.name: [Hologram] Damage Enhancement
80013214.desc: Links the holographic simulation to your combat system. Deduces optimizations for attacks through combat data collected in real time.\n\n#cCan be stacked up to Lv. 3 as an equipment skill. A prismatic jewel will be required from Lv. 4 onwards.

80013215.name: [Hologram] Attack Power & Magic ATT Enhancement
80013215.desc: Links the holographic simulation to your combat system. Deduces optimizations for attacks through combat data collected in real time.\n\n#cCan be stacked up to Lv. 3 as an equipment skill. A prismatic jewel will be required from Lv. 4 onwards.
80013215.h: Attack Power: +#padR%, Magic ATT: +#madR%\n[Passive Effect - Final Damage: +#dummyStr%]

80013216.name: [Hologram] Boss Damage Increase Enhancement
80013216.desc: Links the holographic simulation to your combat system. Deduces optimizations for attacks through combat data collected in real time.\n\n#cCan be stacked up to Lv. 3 as an equipment skill. A prismatic jewel will be required from Lv. 4 onwards.

80013217.name: [Hologram] Ignore Defense Enhancement
80013217.desc: Links the holographic simulation to your combat system. Deduces optimizations for attacks through combat data collected in real time.\n\n#cCan be stacked up to Lv. 3 as an equipment skill. A prismatic jewel will be required from Lv. 4 onwards.

80013325.name: Entropy
80013325.desc: #c[Level 1]# All systems tend naturally towards disorder. This program merely hastens the process.
80013325.h: Final Damage: +#50%\n#30% chance to get 1 Disorder stack upon entering a floor.\nYou will exit the dungeon upon obtaining #x Disorder stacks.

80013326.name: Emergency Backup
80013326.desc: #c[Level 1]# An emergency restoration program that rolls your body back to a previous version where it isn't about to be immediately destroyed. WARNING: Back Up Point Unknown.
80013326.h: Restores #y% of Max HP immediately when HP falls below #x%\n#cooltimeMS sec cooldown

80013327.name: Invincibility
80013327.desc: Temporarily take no damage when entering the floor.
